title: Research Scientist- Robotics AI
description:
As a Research Scientist- Robotics AI, you contribute to research projects at the forefront of the Embodied and Cyber-physical AI industry. Key responsibilities include:
Key Responsibilities
Conduct research and engineering in core AI and machine learning fields to enable industrial embodied AI—including computer vision, autonomous navigation, and adaptive manipulation—specifically for manufacturing, shop-floor automation, logistics, and material handling domains.
Push the boundaries in industrial robotics by incorporating advancements in large vision-language-action models to enhance real-time factory reasoning, multi-robot coordination, and operational safety.
Collaborate cross-functionally with global manufacturing engineering, plant operations, and product development teams to ensure seamless technology transfer from simulation to physical shop-floor hardware and systems integration.
Implement research results to solve complex, real-world industrial challenges, ensuring high-reliability system integration within Bosch’s smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 platforms (such as APAS and active production environments).
Stay at the forefront of industrial innovation by actively engaging with manufacturing technology consortia, automation communities, and specialized conferences focused on industrial robotics and factory automation.
Document and disseminate research findings through high-caliber publications, industry white papers, and/or foundational patent submissions tailored to industrial automation and robotics.
Basic Qualifications
Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics or a related discipline or Master's degree with >= 2/4 years industry experience after graduation.
A minimum of 5 years of R&D experience, or an equivalent graduate research background, primarily in AI technologies including Computer Vision and Robotic or Automotive Motion and Behavioral Planning.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in machine learning (e.g., Python, C++, Rust).
Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork capabilities.
Knowledge of major machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Hands-on experience in reinforcement learning for behavior or motion planning or other applicable contexts and familiarity with common RL techniques (e.g. PPO, DQN, DDPG).
A strong portfolio of publications in premier machine learning, deep learning, robotics and computer vision journals and conferences.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with real-world product development and deployment of autonomous systems.
Hands-on experience building and applying multimodal transformer-based sequence-to-sequence models, especially multimodal vision-language-action models.
Hands-on experience in computer vision and deep learning, with work in any of the following areas: multimodal transformers, multimodal language models, diffusion models, NeRF, gaussian splatting, object detection / segmentation, 3D scene understanding, sensor calibration, SfM, voxel/BEV grid-based feature representation.

title: PhD - Neurosymbolic Reasoning for Domain-Adaptive Generative AI
description:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks. However, their performance often degrades in highly specialized domains that require precise structural reasoning, consistency, and domain-specific knowledge. In electronic hardware design, existing LLMs struggle with the structural and semantic complexity of circuit descriptions. Hardware designs are represented as interconnected graphs, including netlists, schematics, and hierarchical design projects. These representations carry essential information that is lost when converted into purely sequential text.
As a part of our team, you will research novel methods for adapting generative AI systems to specialized domains by integrating structured symbolic knowledge, without relying on extensive model retraining.
Your investigation will focus on mechanisms that enable Large Language Models (LLMs) and other foundation models to leverage external knowledge representations such as knowledge graphs, ontologies, and formal design representations while preserving the reasoning capabilities of symbolic systems.
You will develop innovative approaches that enable generative AI models to interact directly with these structured representations, allowing for more precise reasoning, design assistance, verification, and code generation.
Through your work, you will make a key contribution to the development of next-generation AI systems that combine the flexibility of neural models with the reliability, interpretability, and structured reasoning capabilities of symbolic representations.
Education: excellent Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field
Experience and Knowledge: solid knowledge of computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, or electrical engineering; experience with deep learning, graph algorithms, and knowledge representation; knowledge of hardware design is an advantage
Personality and Working Practice: you approach interdisciplinary research questions with curiosity and creativity, engage openly with others, communicate your ideas clearly, and actively seek out new challenges
Languages: fluent in English, German is a plus

Eigenverantwortlich entwickelst du Web-Applikationen und etablierst die zugehörige Deployment-Pipeline.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Business Process Fachkräften gestaltest du semantische Datenmodelle.
Darüber hinaus erstellst du funktionale sowie nicht-funktionale Anforderungen, stimmst diese intern ab, validierst die Implementierung und bringst dich in die Programmierung ein.
Im kleinen Team gestaltest du gemeinsam Lösungen, erhältst wertvolles Feedback und gewinnst tiefe Einblicke in IT-Architekturen, RDF und Graph-Datenbanken.
Nicht zuletzt pflegst du den Austausch mit anderen Bosch Geschäftsbereichen und Zentralabteilungen, eignest dir Best Practices an und erweiterst dein persönliches Netzwerk.
Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich Informatik oder vergleichbar
Erfahrungen und Know-how: erste Erfahrungen in der Web-Applikations-Entwicklung; gute Programmierkenntnisse in Javascript, Typescript oder React; erste Erfahrungen mit SQL-Datenbanken
Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: dir gelingt es, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu erfassen und klar zu kommunizieren; du bringst dich gerne in ein Team ein, zeigst dich offen für neue Ansätze und arbeitest eigenständig an deinen Aufgaben
Arbeitsalltag: Anwesenheit im Büro erforderlich
Begeisterung: für neue Arbeitsgebiete und bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich tief in neue Themen einzuarbeiten
Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch
Beginn: ab März 2027
Dauer: 6 Monate (ausschließlich Pflichtpraktikum gem. SPO möglich)
Wir bieten dir:
35 Stunden/Woche mit Gleitzeit
eine feste Ansprechperson, die dich während deines Praktikums begleitet
eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung, sowie mobiles Arbeiten nach Absprache
die Möglichkeit Teil unseres studentischen Netzwerkes students@bosch Stuttgart zu werden
Vergünstigungen in unseren Betriebsrestaurants

► Develop and optimize solutions using Power BI, DAX, DAX Studio and Microsoft Fabric

► Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, analytics and reporting

► Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services

► German language skills

title: [2WP]  二輪車ARASシステム/機能開発エンジニア/Advanced Rider Assistance Systems - Feature Developer
description:
主な仕事内容
アルゴリズム・機能開発
最新のC/C++を使用し、レーダーベースのARAS（先進ライダー支援システム）機能の設計、実装、最適化を行います。
プラットフォーム開発・OEM向けインテグレーション
拡張性の高いコアプラットフォームソフトウェアを開発するとともに、世界各国の二輪車メーカーごとに異なる車両ダイナミクス、シャシー特性、デザイン上の制約に合わせて機能を適合させます。
実車テスト・キャリブレーション
那須塩原のテストコース（横浜オフィスから約3時間、定期的な出張あり）や一般公道にて、テスト用モーターサイクルを使用した機能評価、データ収集、初期キャリブレーションを行います。
部門横断・グローバルな連携
Vモデルに基づく開発プロセス全体を通じて、海外の機能開発チーム、システムエンジニア、機能安全マネージャー、アプリケーションエンジニアと密接に連携します。
ツール開発・シミュレーション・データ解析
ベンチテストや走行テストで収集したレーダーセンサーのデータを処理・解析するため、Pythonを用いたテストパイプライン、シミュレーション環境、計測スクリプトの開発を行います。
このポジションの魅力
仕事の意義と大きなインパクト
世界中のライダーの安全を守る、モーターサイクル向け安全技術の開発に直接携わることができます。
実車に触れられるエンジニアリング環境
開発専用のモーターサイクル、クローズドテストコースを利用できるほか、高度なライディング・ダイナミクストレーニングを受けられる環境があります。
日本からグローバルに活躍
Bosch 2WPのグローバル本部で、世界各国のチームや主要な海外二輪車メーカーと国境を越えて協働することができます。
成長機会とモダンな働き方
継続的な専門トレーニング、最先端の開発環境、競争力のある報酬制度、柔軟なハイブリッドワーク制度を提供しています。
What You Will Do
Algorithm & Feature Development: Design, implement, and optimize radar-based ARAS functions using modern C/C++.
Platform & OEM Integration: Develop scalable core platform software while adapting features to match the unique vehicle dynamics, chassis behavior, and styling constraints of global motorcycle OEMs.
Hands-On Vehicle Testing & Calibration: Perform functional evaluations, data collection and initial calibration on test motorcycles at our Nasushiobara Proving Ground (regular trips, ~3 hours from Yokohama office) and on public roads.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with international feature development teams, system engineers, functional safety managers and application engineers throughout the V-model lifecycle.
Tooling, Simulation & Data Analysis: Develop Python-based test pipelines, simulation environments, and measurement scripts to process and analyze radar sensor recordings from bench and track tests.
What We Offer:
Direct Purpose & Impact: Contribute directly to life-saving motorcycle safety innovations experienced by riders around the world.
Hands-On Engineering Culture: Direct access to dedicated development motorcycles, closed proving grounds, and advanced rider dynamics training.
Global Exposure from Japan: Work at the worldwide headquarters of Bosch 2WP, collaborating across borders with premium international motorcycle manufacturers.
Growth & Modern Workplace: Continuous professional training, cutting-edge development environments, competitive compensation, and flexible hybrid working arrangements.
応募必須条件（Must-Haves）
学歴
コンピューターサイエンス、ソフトウェア工学、自動車工学、電気工学、メカトロニクス、または関連分野の学士号もしくは修士号を取得している方。
ソフトウェア開発スキル
リアルタイム組み込みソフトウェアまたは機能ソフトウェア開発における、C/C++の高いスキルを有する方。加えて、テスト、自動化、データ処理に使用できるPythonの実務知識をお持ちの方。
関連分野での経験
自動車向け機能開発の経験を有する方。特に、レーダーやカメラなどの環境認識センサー、またはESP/ABSなどのシャシー制御システムに関する経験がある方。
ダイナミクス・制御理論の知識
制御理論、車両運動力学、物理学について十分な知識を有する方。特に、モーターサイクルの安定性や車両挙動に関わるARAS機能の開発において大きな強みとなります。
モーターサイクルへの情熱・運転免許
有効な二輪車運転免許を保有し、日常的なライディング経験がある方。また、クローズドコースおよび一般公道での実車テストに抵抗なく参加できる方。
コミュニケーション能力
海外の開発拠点と日常的に連携できる、ビジネスレベル以上の英語力（会話・読み書き）を有する方。
歓迎条件（Nice-to-Haves）
日本語力
国内OEMや社内関係者と直接コミュニケーションを取るための、ビジネスレベルの日本語力（会話および技術文書の読み書き）。
システム・機能安全エンジニアリング
ISO 26262に基づく機能安全、ASPICE、および要件管理システム（IBM DOORS、Codebeamerなど）に関する実務経験。
機械学習・AI
センサーデータ処理や軌道推定などに、ニューラルネットワークや機械学習技術を適用した経験。
自動車開発ツール
Vector CANoe、CANapeなどのツール、Gitによるバージョン管理、およびCI/CDを用いた最新のソフトウェア開発環境に関する知識・経験。
二輪車の安全の未来を、一緒につくりませんか？
横浜の私たちのチームに加わり、次世代の二輪車安全技術を一緒に形にしていきましょう。ぜひご応募ください。
What You Bring (Must-Haves):
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
Software Development Skills: Strong proficiency in C/C++ for real-time embedded or function software development, alongside working knowledge of Python for testing, automation, and data processing.
Domain Experience: Experience in automotive function development, particularly with environmental sensors (e.g., radar, cameras) and/or chassis control systems (ESP/ABS).
Dynamics & Control Theory: A strong grasp of control theory, vehicle dynamics, and physics (highly beneficial for motorcycle stability and motion-related ARAS features).
Rider Passion & License: Valid motorcycle driver's license with active riding experience, comfortable participating in closed-course and public road vehicle testing.
Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) for daily collaboration across international development centers.
What Sets You Apart (Nice-to-Haves):
Language Skills: Professional working proficiency in Japanese (spoken and technical written) to interface directly with domestic OEM partners and local stakeholders.
Systems & Safety Engineering: Practical exposure to ISO 26262 functional safety, ASPICE, and requirement management systems (e.g., IBM DOORS, Codebeamer).
Machine Learning & AI: Experience applying neural networks or machine learning techniques to sensor data processing or trajectory estimation.
Automotive Tooling: Familiarity with Vector tools (CANoe, CANape), Git version control, and modern CI/CD software pipelines.
Ready to shape the future of two-wheeler safety? Apply now and become part of our team in Yokohama.

title: Business Developer Climatisation H/F/N
description:
Rattaché au Responsable National des Grands Comptes, le Business Developer Climatisation a pour mission de développer un nouveau levier de croissance en structurant et en déployant le réseau des spécialistes de la climatisation.
Ce poste s'inscrit en complément de l'action des équipes Grands Comptes qui ont développé les réseaux traditionnels de la distribution Sanitaire chauffage et électricité. Il a pour vocation d'ouvrir et de structurer un troisième réseau dédié aux spécialistes de la climatisation. (Distributeurs spécialisés, climaticiens, frigoristes, entreprises de maintenance et réseaux professionnels).
Véritable développeur de marché, il est responsable de la conquête, de la structuration et de l'animation de ce nouveau canal de développement. Il identifie, contractualise et accompagne les partenaires stratégiques afin d'accroître durablement la présence de Bosch Home Comfort sur ce marché, tout en préservant la cohérence et les équilibres des réseaux de distribution existant
Il contribue ainsi à créer le 3e pilier de notre développement commercial en mettant en place un écosystème complet associant distribution spécialisée, installation et maintenance.
Au-delà de ses qualités commerciales, le Business Developer Climatisation est avant tout un développeur de marché. Il sait identifier des opportunités, bâtir une stratégie de conquête, convaincre de nouveaux partenaires et fédérer les équipes internes autour d'un objectif commun.
Vos principales missions
Développer le réseau spécialiste
Identifier les acteurs stratégiques du marché (Clim+, Rolesco, 3C Clim, Climaticiens de France, Kaéli…).
Prospecter, négocier et contractualiser de nouveaux partenariats.
Construire un réseau national de partenaires spécialisés.
Déployer la stratégie marché
Définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de conquête à court, moyen et long terme.
Développer les synergies entre distribution spécialisée, installation et maintenance.
Identifier les relais de croissance et les nouveaux modèles de développement.
Développer les partenaires
Accompagner techniquement et commercialement les partenaires.
Participer aux formations, événements et opérations de développement.
Animer le réseau afin de développer les ventes et la notoriété de la marque.
Piloter le développement
Mener les négociations commerciales.
Assurer le suivi des accords conclus.
Réaliser une veille marché et concurrentielle afin d'adapter la stratégie.
Formation
Bac +3 à Bac +5 dans les domaines du commerce et du génie climatique.
Expérience
Expérience confirmée dans le secteur de la climatisation, du génie climatique ou du froid.
Expérience réussie en développement commercial, grands comptes ou business development.
Compétences techniques
Excellente connaissance du marché de la climatisation.
Solide maîtrise des PAC Air/Air résidentielles et tertiaires.
Bonne connaissance des systèmes VRF et des enjeux liés à leur mise en œuvre.
Compréhension des métiers de l'installation, du froid et de la maintenance.
Bonne connaissance des circuits de distribution spécialisés climatisation.
Compétences commerciales
Forte capacité de prospection et à créer un réseau de partenaires à partir d'une feuille blanche.
Bon négociateur.
Aisance dans les relations avec les décideurs (dirigeants, acheteurs, responsables techniques).
Capacité à fédérer les équipes commerciales, marketing et techniques autour d'une stratégie commune et à évoluer dans une organisation matricielle
Qualités personnelles
Vision stratégique.
Esprit entrepreneurial.
Excellent relationnel.
Forte autonomie.
Capacité à fédérer des partenaires et les équipes internes.
Goût du terrain.
Résilient.
Anglais B2 est un plus
A l’occasion du CES2021, Bosch a annoncé avoir atteint la neutralité carbone en 2020 sur l’ensemble de ses 400 sites dans le monde et se fixe un nouvel objectif en tablant sur une réduction de 15 % des émissions sur le scope 3 à l’horizon 2030. Venez rejoindre une entreprise qui agit pour le climat !

title: Embedded Software Engineer - Radar Systems  (f/m/div.)
description:
Your contribution to something big:
Help bring the software behind next-generation radar systems from development into production.
As an Embedded Software Integration Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring that software contributions from different technical teams come together as a mature, validated and production-ready solution.
Working at the intersection of embedded software, hardware, security, validation and manufacturing, you will coordinate technical dependencies, create transparency on software maturity and help ensure that the right content and configurations are ready before deployment into production.
This is a technical coordination role where your ability to connect teams, understand technical dependencies and drive topics forward will be just as important as your embedded software knowledge.
In this role, you will:
Coordinate the preparation and delivery of production-ready embedded software, ensuring that required software contributions and production-relevant configurations are complete and aligned.
Manage technical dependencies and open topics across embedded software, hardware, security, validation, project and manufacturing teams.
Provide transparency on software maturity, validation status, dependencies, delivery risks and open issues, driving clarification and escalation when required.
Act as the central coordination interface for software-related production readiness and manufacturing topics, connecting issues with the appropriate technical owners.
Coordinate validation and readiness checks to identify incomplete, incorrect or incompatible software content before deployment into manufacturing.
Facilitate technical collaboration and decision-making across multiple teams, ensuring clear ownership and consistent follow-up of actions.
Drive preventive improvements across the software-to-production delivery process, reducing recurring issues and supporting more robust releases.
Continuously expand your understanding of radar system-level dependencies, supporting increasingly broad technical coordination topics.
Explore opportunities to apply software-defined and agentic engineering approaches to improve engineering and delivery processes.
What distinguishes you:
Education
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related technical field.
Experience
Relevant experience in embedded software development, software integration, technical coordination, validation, release management or system engineering.
Experience working across different technical teams and coordinating software dependencies or deliverables.
Experience with software integration and release processes in complex embedded environments.
Exposure to manufacturing, industrialization or production deployment environments is valuable.
Experience in automotive electronics or radar systems is an advantage.
Know-how
Good understanding of embedded systems, software lifecycles, software integration and release processes.
Knowledge of software configuration management and production-relevant software configurations.
Understanding of software validation and readiness activities before release or deployment.
Ability to understand dependencies between software, hardware, security and manufacturing within complex embedded systems.
Knowledge of production environments and their specific software requirements and constraints is valuable.
Understanding of production-related security configurations and release content management is an advantage.
Interest in software-defined and agentic engineering approaches and their potential application within engineering processes is valued.
Languages
Very good command of English, written and spoken, enabling effective collaboration across international and cross-functional engineering teams.
Working Style and Methods
You approach complex technical dependencies in a structured, analytical and solution-oriented way.
You create transparency around priorities, risks, dependencies and required decisions.
You proactively identify potential issues and coordinate the right stakeholders to resolve them before they affect production.
You are comfortable coordinating multiple technical topics and teams without needing formal authority over them.
You balance technical understanding with a strong focus on delivery, quality and production readiness.
Personality
You are a strong communicator who enjoys connecting people across different technical disciplines.
You take ownership and proactively follow topics through to resolution.
You are collaborative and confident in facilitating alignment between stakeholders with different priorities.
You are curious and interested in expanding your knowledge from embedded software towards radar systems and system-level engineering.
You enjoy improving processes and exploring new approaches that can make engineering work more efficient.

title: Master Thesis - Benchmarking AI on Resource-Constrained Micro Drones
description:
Problem statement
In this Master Thesis in Software Engineering, the focus will be on defining and validating a benchmarking framework for AI models deployed on micro-drones. Due to the constrained nature of the micro-drone platforms, it offers challenges regarding limited processing power, memory, energy, payload capacity, and flight time. These limitations make it difficult to determine whether an AI or machine-learning model that performs well in simulation will operate efficiently and reliably also on the target hardware.
The central research question is: which benchmarking metrics are the most effective for measuring the performance of AI models deployed on resource-constrained micro-drones? The work should identify suitable key performance indicators (KPIs), with a need to understand and investigate the trade-offs between model performance and drone constraints, to finally, define a pragmatic test scenario that fits the available timebox and hardware availability.
The project will build on simulation environment, simulation data and will be tested via existing hardware and software environment, with provided drone components, programming and control interfaces, Machine Learning/AI drone knowledge, and drone related simulation assets. The evaluation will therefore connect model-level measurements with the realities of embedded deployment and bounded flight testing.
Proposed solution
The proposed solution is to design and implement a repeatable benchmarking framework for testing AI models into a micro-drone target, first with simulation, but also with deployment of the model on a real micro-drone platform, this test framework will capture relevant measurements, and will support a structured comparison of performance indicators.
The work will include: Benchmark definition: Identify and define metrics which characterize the model quality, execution performance, resource usage, energy-related trade-offs and operational behavior.
Deployment pipeline: Review and adapt the current pipeline for integrating and running selected ML inference models on micro-drone hardware targets.
Model and scenario selection: Select suitable available models and define one controlled, fingerprint scenario and a test environment for meaningful and reproducible evaluation.
Framework implementation: Develop the measurement, logging, analysis, and reporting workflow needed to extract benchmarking parameters from the micro-drone.
Validation: Run a focused test suite, first on simulation, then, compare results across relevant configurations, and assess how the chosen metrics support practical deployment decisions.
The expected result is a Proof-of-Concept benchmarking framework and a documented evaluation method for micro-drone platforms. The work is deliberately bounded; it does not aim to create an all-case autonomous flight solution but to create the bases within a specific micro-drone flight scenario for benchmark testing. The student will have the opportunity to shape the final selection of models, metrics, and test scenarios based on feasibility and findings during the project.
Your profile
In order to be successful in this project, we think you are:
A student in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Mathematics or Physics.
Have relevant coursework or knowledge in data science, control systems, and AI.
Experienced with or have at least basic programming knowledge in Python, C++ or similar languages.
Self-driven, able to take initiative and move the project forward independently.
A person with team spirit, social skills, and genuine curiosity for robotics, AI and autonomous systems.
Two students completing 30 credits each (20 weeks) onsite at the Lund office
Please note: Applications from students located in the areas of Lund and Malmö are prefered.
Contact: Diego Medina, mail Diego.Medina@se.bosch.com

title: AI Developer
description:

Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.
You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.

Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

About Sodalis
Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.
Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.
We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).
Â
The Opportunity
Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.
We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.
What you'll do
Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.
Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.
Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.
Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.
Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.
What we're looking for
5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.
You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.
You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.
You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.
You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.
You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.
How we work
We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About us:
Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.
Why we exist:
Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.
Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.
We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).
Why We’re Hiring
Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.
Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.
As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:
Growth Marketing
Product Development
Strategic Partnerships
On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.
Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here
No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.
What You'll Own
You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.
Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.
Who You Are
First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.
What You'll Bring
2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.
Our Tools
SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.
While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.
Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.
Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.
About Jerry.ai
Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.
Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.
Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.
We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.
Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.
We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.
We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

title: AI Solutions Engineer - Agents & Automation - North Macedonia
description:
About Us
HeadQuarters is a global start-up that partners with US cannabis companies to provide support in finance, sales operations, and logistics. We are currently seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to join our growing product development team.
The Role
We're hiring an engineer to design and build AI agents and automations for our external customers in the fast growing Cannabis / CPG industry. You'll partner with our team from the first conversation through delivery: understanding a customer's workflows, scoping what an agent should own, building it on top of their systems, and making sure it runs reliably in production.The most important part of this job is learning how a customer's work actually gets done: sitting with their frontline staff, earning their trust, and turning unwritten rules and exceptions into logic a system can follow.
Once an agent is live, you'll hand it off to one of our Operations Managers, who oversee the agent's day-to-day work and output on the customer's behalf.
Every customer runs on a different stack, so this role calls for real engineering depth, and you don't need a long AI resume to have it. We're looking for a strong developer who has recently put LLM-powered workflows into production. Plenty of people can prompt their way to a working prototype. We need someone who can own the code behind it, troubleshoot it inside an unfamiliar environment, and harden it so it holds up long after you've moved on to the next customer.
What You'll Do
Discovery and Scoping (with the AI Sales Lead)
Sit with customers' frontline staff to learn how the work actually gets done, capture the rules and exceptions that live in people's heads, and translate them into explicit logic
Build trust with the people whose work you're automating, and treat them as the experts on their process
Assess technical feasibility and identify which tasks are good candidates for an agent and where human review should stay in the loop
Translate customer needs into solution designs, effort estimates, and clear scope
Build proofs of concept and demos that show customers what an agent can do with their own workflows
Provide build and run cost estimates (model usage, infrastructure, maintenance) to support pricing
Join customer discovery calls to understand their workflows, systems, data, and pain points
Build and Deploy
Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automations that handle multi-step workflows across customer operations
Build and configure integrations that link each customer's tools, such as CRMs, ERPs, accounting platforms, email, messaging, and document storage, using APIs where they exist and browser automation where they don't
Write production-quality Python for integrations, data transformation, and agent tooling
Use SQL to validate agent outputs, reconcile records across systems, and measure accuracy
Build error handling, retries, idempotency, logging, alerting, and graceful fallbacks into everything you ship
Create testing and evaluation processes for each agent: test sets, regression checks, and accuracy tracking before go-live and after every change
Architect deployments so each customer's data, credentials, and permissions stay fully isolated
Handoff and Support
Hand off live agents to Operations Managers with runbooks, monitoring dashboards, review queues, and clear escalation paths
Train Operations Managers to supervise agent output, spot problems early, and handle routine exceptions without engineering help
Serve as the technical escalation point when an agent fails or a customer's systems change
Use what you learn from each deployment to build reusable components, templates, and deployment patterns that make the next customer faster to deliver
Measure and report impact for each customer against a baseline: hours saved, turnaround time, error rates, and cost per run
First-Year Mission
Your first year is measured by the operating results customers see, not by how many agents you deliver.
Establish a baseline for every customer workflow you take on: hours spent, turnaround time, error rates, and cost
Deliver measurable, sustained improvements against those baselines for customers across multiple industries
Shorten the time from signed agreement to measurable customer results
Hand off agents that Operations Managers run day to day with minimal engineering involvement
Earn renewals and expansions because the results hold up over time
Requirements
3+ years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, or automation engineering experience
Proof of recent production LLM workflows: something you built with Claude, OpenAI, or a similar platform that real users rely on
Strong Python: you structure, test, and debug your code, and you understand what AI-generated code is doing before you ship it
Strong SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions, and tracking down data quality problems
Browser automation experience with Playwright or a similar tool, for systems with limited or no APIs
Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, pagination, and rate limits across a wide range of third-party platforms
A track record of troubleshooting production failures: reading logs and stack traces, isolating root causes, and fixing them permanently
Comfort with Bash and the command line for deployment, scheduling, and debugging
Git and version control as a standard part of how you work

title: Clinical Data Engineer (Application Engineer)
description:
Department Overview
The mission of the Information Technology Group (ITG) is to provide and support technology and information services that enable OHSU to be a national leader in health and science innovation. The work of the Business Intelligence & Advanced Analytics Division (BIAA) is to deliver meaningful analytic solutions by bringing together data, systems, and people to enhance the work and lives of OHSU members and the communities we serve.
Function/Duties of Position
The Clinical Data Engineer sits on the clinical data team within the broader Clinical Business Intelligence unit, alongside analysts, engineers, administrators, and architects. This position builds new clinical data warehousing solutions, data transformations, and data integration assets, and supports the changes, enhancements, and maintenance of existing assets in support of OHSU clinical data initiatives.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams — clinical and operational stakeholders, data architects, and IT specialists — to develop robust data pipelines, implement data quality controls, and deliver trustworthy data that supports clinical decision-making. Development happens primarily in the Epic Caboodle Console, Microsoft SQL Server tools, and Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering tools, with Azure DevOps for version control, code management, and deployment. Duties may extend to other cloud data engineering tools, such as Apache Airflow, as needed.
Key responsibilities include:
Design and develop ETL pipelines that extract, transform, and load clinical data from a variety of sources into structures suitable for analysis.
Implement data quality controls that validate, monitor, and maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of clinical data across the pipeline lifecycle.
Contribute to the growth of the OHSU Caboodle Data Warehouse by designing, developing, testing, and implementing custom clinical data models.
Partner with BI architects, developers, analysts, and customers (practice managers, data scientists, quality analysts) to build and publish data models, ETL processes, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Notebooks, and metadata using the Epic Caboodle Console and third-party ETL tools.
Develop data feeds using SSIS or similar tools, ensuring appropriate security review and transport consistent with information privacy and security requirements, business associate agreements, and data use agreements.
Document warehouse content in the Caboodle Console and the Analytics Marketplace so users can determine what data exists, how it is defined, and how it traces back to Epic Clarity.
Troubleshoot ETL failures, data anomalies, and warehouse issues surfaced by automated monitoring, other developers, and end users; resolve or escalate through established processes and communicate status to affected groups.
Recommend improvements to ETL processes, tool sets, data models, and monitoring techniques that increase reliability and efficiency.
Deploy warehouse content using approved Azure DevOps systems and processes, and follow approved SDLC practices throughout.
Manage assigned projects by building timelines, identifying risks and milestones, and reporting status.
Respond to and track issues in Jira Service Desk, gathering information from customers and triaging to resolution.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related field, or a clinical field and six years of work-related experience in the information technology field or a combination of clinical or operational healthcare environments; OR
Associate’s degree in computer science, a related field, or a clinical field and seven years of work-related experience in the information technology field or a combination of clinical or operational healthcare environments; OR
Eight years work related experience in the information technology field or a combination of clinical or operational healthcare environments; OR
Equivalent combination of education and experience where one year of experience will be substituted for an Associate’s degree and two years of experience will be substituted
for a Bachelor’s degree.
Experience
Minimum of two (2) years of experience as an Application Engineer or Developer (or equivalent classification) developing data warehouse objects and data integration ETL solutions.
Minimum of three (3) years SQL Server Experience, including SSIS and T-SQL, coding, performance tuning, and system optimization.
Minimum of five (5) years with Microsoft SQL Server T-SQL.
Minimum of two (2) years of experience in a medallion architecture data warehouse environment.
One year of experience with Microsoft Fabric using OneLake and Data Engineering tools.
One year of experience with Python or PySpark.
Skills and Abilities
Knowledge of data warehousing architecture and dimensional modeling concepts.
Knowledge of data validation and testing methodologies for ETL processes.
Familiarity with data governance and cataloging practices.
Proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities and communicate progress on an ongoing basis with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to accurately document system technical artifacts at a level of detail sufficient for ongoing production support.
Certifications
Epic Clarity Data Model Certifications and Epic Caboodle Developer Certification within 6 months of hire.
Microsoft DP-700 Fabric Data Engineer certification within 9 months of hire.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with the Epic Clarity and Caboodle data models.
Experience planning and managing small projects.
Experience with HIPAA and PHI compliance.
Microsoft DP-700 Fabric Data Engineer Certification.
Additional Details
Benefits
Healthcare for full-time employees covered 100% and 88% for dependents.
$50K of term life insurance provided at no cost to the employee.
Two separate above market pension plans to choose from.
Vacation - up to 200 hours per year dependent on length of service.
Sick Leave - up to 96 hours per year.
9 paid holidays per year.
Substantial Tri-Met and C-Tran discounts.
Employee Assistance Program.
Childcare service discounts.
Tuition reimbursement.
Employee discounts to local and national businesses.
Why apply to OHSU?
We are Oregon's only public academic health center. In addition to caring for patients, we lead groundbreaking research. We also train the next generation of health care professionals. As Portland's largest employer, we give you opportunities to learn and advance in a system of hospitals and clinics across Oregon and Southwest Washington. All are welcome. title: AI Engineer
description:
About the Company
Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development.
In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment.
Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most.
Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment.
Position Overview
As an AI Engineer at Ajaia, you will build AI-enabled software across both client engagements and internal product initiatives where technical speed, adaptability, and execution quality matter.
You will own features from start to finish: take loosely defined requirements, clarify the real problem, and ship robust solutions across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, and AI-driven workflows. You will also set up the infrastructure, deployments, and security those features need to run safely in production.
This is an individual contributor role for someone who builds with autonomy while working closely with product, delivery, and client-facing teams, and who helps newer engineers along the way.
Every role at Ajaia is AI-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling.
Primary Responsibilities
Own AI-enabled features end to end for client delivery systems, internal platforms, and products.
Work across frontend implementation, backend logic, API design, and database operations.
Build and integrate AI capabilities into production systems: LLM APIs, prompt workflows, retrieval (RAG), agents, and automation.
Set up and maintain the infrastructure your features run on: cloud services, environments, and configuration.
Own deployments for your features: CI/CD pipelines, releases, rollbacks, and environment management.
Apply security best practices in daily work: secure authentication, secrets management, access control, and protection against common vulnerabilities (such as the OWASP Top 10).
Use AI tools regularly for coding support, debugging, technical research, test generation, and documentation.
Turn ambiguous requests into clear technical tasks, estimates, and delivery plans.
Identify risks early and unblock execution through pragmatic decisions.
Review code from peers and help junior engineers with patterns and practices.
Keep systems maintainable, secure, observable, and ready for continuous iteration.
Requirements
2–5 years of hands-on experience building and shipping software in professional environments.
Solid experience with a modern frontend framework (such as React or Next.js) and a backend stack (such as Python/FastAPI or Node.js).
Experience with APIs, relational databases (such as PostgreSQL or MySQL), and authentication.
Experience building features on top of large language models (prompting, tool use, retrieval, or agent workflows).
Infrastructure: hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or Google Cloud Platform), containers (Docker), and core services such as compute, storage, networking, and managed databases.
Deployments: experience building and running CI/CD pipelines (such as GitHub Actions), deploying to production, and handling releases and rollbacks safely.
Security: working knowledge of secure coding, authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT), secrets management, encryption, and common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).
Ownership mindset and ability to deliver without highly detailed requirements.
Comfort managing multiple priorities or workstreams in a fast-moving consultancy or product environment.
Proficiency with GitHub and modern developer tooling.
Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Active daily use of AI tools for planning, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation.
Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated output and hold a high standard for correctness and reliability.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience shipping AI features to production users.
Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, vector databases, or LLM evaluation.
Experience working in startup, consultancy, or fast-iteration environments.
Schedule and Location
This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance requirements.
Working schedule follows Eastern Time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, including holidays.
Technical Requirements
Reliable wired internet connection with at least 100 Mbps speed.
Computer or laptop with Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 processor or higher.
Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 128 GB available storage.
Dual-monitor setup preferred.
Windows 10 or macOS (latest version).
1080p webcam and working microphone.
Backup solutions for power and internet interruptions.
Benefits
Compensation: USD 12,500 per year base salary + Performance Bonus
Remote work with earned flexibility.
Professional development opportunities.
Paid time off.
Why Join Ajaia
This role gives you exposure to a wide range of applied AI and software delivery challenges while keeping you close to real implementation work. You will build across client and internal initiatives, work directly with operators and technical leaders, and grow toward senior ownership.
The environment rewards ownership, speed, and clarity rather than bureaucracy.
Experience the Ajaia difference. Let's build what's next.

title: Physician (MD/DO) - Medical AI Evaluation (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
About the company
Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.
Project Highlights
Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
All contributors are license-verified physicians
$50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved
What this project involves
We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:
Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.
Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.
What we look for
This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:
Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
Strong written English (C1+).
This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.
How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks
Flexibility
You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.
Earnings
Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.
$50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

Σχεδιασμός και ανάπτυξη λύσεων NLP με χρήση Large Language Models (π.χ. OpenAI, HuggingFace Transformers, LLaMA, Mistral κ.ά.).
Fine-tuning και βελτιστοποίηση προεκπαιδευμένων μοντέλων σε εξειδικευμένα datasets.
Ανάπτυξη pipelines για data preprocessing, training, evaluation και deployment σε cloud/edge περιβάλλοντα.
Συμμετοχή σε έργα R&D που ενσωματώνουν AI σε επιχειρησιακές και ερευνητικές πλατφόρμες.
Συνεργασία με Software Engineers, UI/UX Designers και Systems Architects για την ολοκληρωμένη υλοποίηση λύσεων.
Συμβολή στη συγγραφή τεχνικών παραδοτέων και τεκμηρίωσης AI modules.
Παρακολούθηση εξελίξεων στον χώρο του NLP & LLMs και εισαγωγή νέων μεθοδολογιών.

Πτυχίο ΑΕΙ σε Πληροφορική, Ηλεκτρολόγων Μηχανικών ή συναφές πεδίο Πληροφορικής / τεχνολογίας Υπολογιστών.
Απαραίτητο Μεταπτυχιακό σε Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη.
Επαγγελματική ή ερευνητική εμπειρία σε έργα NLP και Machine Learning.
Άριστη γνώση Python και ML libraries (π.χ. TensorFlow, PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers).
Εμπειρία σε fine-tuning και ανάπτυξη εφαρμογών βασισμένων σε LLMs.

Εμπειρία σε χρήση APIs μεγάλων μοντέλων (π.χ. OpenAI API) και ανάπτυξη custom λύσεων.
Εξοικείωση με cloud περιβάλλοντα (AWS, Azure, GCP) ή on-premise AI deployment.
Ικανότητα συγγραφής τεχνικής τεκμηρίωσης στα Αγγλικά.

Εμπειρία σε multilingual NLP projects ή επεξεργασία ελληνικής γλώσσας.
Καλή γνώση MLOps πρακτικών (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).
Εμπειρία σε AI Ethics, Explainability (XAI) και Responsible AI.
Συμμετοχή σε ερευνητικά έργα ή ανάπτυξη prototypes στο πλαίσιο R&D.
Κατανόηση αρχιτεκτονικών Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Εμπειρία σε vector databases (π.χ. FAISS, Pinecone)

Συμμετοχή σε πρωτοποριακά έργα με έμφαση στην Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη και το NLP.
Συνεχής επαγγελματική ανάπτυξη μέσω ενασχόλησης με σύγχρονες AI τεχνολογίες.
Συνεργασία με διεπιστημονικές ομάδες σε διεθνές περιβάλλον.
Δυνατότητα συμβολής στη διαμόρφωση καινοτόμων λύσεων που αξιοποιούν τις τελευταίες εξελίξεις στον χώρο των LLMs.

Εάν σας ενδιαφέρει να συμμετάσχετε σε μια δυναμική ομάδα που αξιοποιεί την Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη για την ανάπτυξη προηγμένων λύσεων, παρακαλούμε αποστείλετε το βιογραφικό σας.

title: Machine Learning Systems Engineer
description:
Mission Summary:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Systems Engineer to join our ML Acceleration team. In this role, you will be responsible for the core systems that enable our researchers to train frontier models at scale, focusing obsessively on speed, cost, reliability, and throughput. You will work at the intersection of machine learning research and high-performance systems engineering. Your work will directly impact our ability to scale large-scale distributed model training and reduce the time-to-convergence for our next generation of models.
What you'll be doing:
Performance Profiling & Optimization: Utilize profiling tools (e.g., Nsight, PyTorch Profiler) to identify bottlenecks in data loading, gradient computation, and communication. Implement optimizations like kernel fusion, sharding, and tiling to improve step time.
Distributed Training: Optimize distributed training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch Distributed.
Kernel Development: Design and maintain high-performance GPU kernels in Triton or CUDA for state-of-the-art ML workloads.
Data Pipeline Engineering: Optimize robust data loading pipelines that maximize training throughput.
What we're looking for:
Education: Bachelor’s, Master’s degree, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python.
ML Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience with PyTorch.
ML Knowledge: Experience optimizing machine learning model execution during training and inference, alongside a strong understanding of fundamental machine learning concepts, architectures, and processes.
Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a bias for action and a data-driven approach to technical challenges.
We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.
The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.
Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional’s benefits program. Motional’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.
Salary Range
$144,000—$192,000 USD
Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.
Our journey is always people first.
We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.
Higher purpose, greater impact.
We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.
Scale up, not starting up.
Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.
Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E-Verify. All newly-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.

title: AI-Native Software Engineer
description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.
About us
Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.
About the role
Most engineering teams have added AI to their workflow. A few have rebuilt their workflow around it. We are moving to the second group, and we are hiring engineers to build it with us.
This is not a role where you build LLM products. This is a role where you build our product with agents.
You will work inside a real, high-traffic production codebase: the platform that 2,000+ brands use to engage customers across channels, processing 2.2 billion requests and delivering nearly 2 billion notifications every day. You will plan, implement, test, review, debug and ship features with coding agents doing most of the writing, while you set the intent and own the outcome.
You are not expected to arrive with a company-wide standard in your head. You are expected to already work this way every day, and to leave the team with better prompts, skills, agents and guardrails than it had before you.
If your first reaction to a repetitive workflow is "this should be an agent," we should probably talk.
Why this role exists
We looked at how our engineers work today. Some of them use AI to finish a line of code faster. That is autocomplete, and it is not what we mean.
We mean the full loop: you scope a change, an agent reads the codebase and writes a plan, you correct the plan, the agent implements across many files, runs the tests, fixes what it broke, and opens a pull request. You review the output like a senior engineer reviews a junior — because that is exactly what it is.
Some people already work like this every day. We want more of them on the team, and we want them building the tooling that makes it easy for everyone else.
What You Will Do
Ship with agents. Claude Code first, plus Codex, Cursor, Copilot or whatever earns its place — your main tool across planning, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, documentation and review. Real features in production, with the quality bar you would hold for hand-written code.
Own the output. Treat what the agent writes as untrusted until you have reviewed it: hallucinations, wrong assumptions, hardcoded secrets, missing validation, injection-prone patterns. Run it, confirm it works, iterate. For authentication, authorization, cryptography and session handling, use our standard implementation rather than the model's invention.
Fix the context, not the prompt. Keep CLAUDE.md, coding standards, architecture notes and module dependencies current so the agent gets it right the first time. Feed SAST (Static Application Security Testing) and dependency findings back with call path and data flow, so it writes a real patch instead of a suppression.
Build team-level tooling. Prompts, skills, sub-agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations for the work that keeps coming back, plus guardrails that keep agents in bounds: architectural limits, forbidden patterns, off-limits folders. Keep the context lean and watch token cost.
Use agents across the whole lifecycle, not just for code. Integration tests and coverage gap analysis, regression tests generated from real production incidents, root-cause analysis with logs and traces pulled in, ADRs (Architecture Decision Record) and runbooks drafted with AI and checked by you.
Review AI-assisted work well. Run context-aware AI review on your own diffs, separate true positives from false positives, and turn recurring false positives or escaped bugs into rules the team keeps.
Share what works. Show your setup to the team, review other people's AI-assisted pull requests, and get at least one thing you built adopted beyond your own repo.
What You Will Need
Must have
Daily use of coding agents on real work. Not a course, not a demo. Code with users, where the agent did a large share of the writing and you owned the result.
At least one project you can walk us through end to end with these tools: what you delegated, what you kept, where it failed you, and how you caught it.
Agentic experience: tool and function calling, multi-step workflows, state, error recovery, human-in-the-loop.
Context discipline. You can show how you set an agent up to succeed — project files, standards, examples, scoped tasks — and how that cut your rework.
Solid engineering fundamentals. Clean code, testing, error handling, security, performance. Agents make weak fundamentals more expensive, not less.
The judgment to know when the agent is wrong. Speed is easy to fake. Judgment is not, and it is what we will test.
Willingness to share it. You do not need to have run a training program. You do need to be the kind of person who shows a teammate the setup instead of keeping it.
Language is not a filter. Go and PHP/Laravel are preferred because that is what we run; Python, TypeScript or anything else is fine if the rest is there.
Nice to have
Team-level tooling you built and other people used: shared skills, sub-agents, MCP servers, slash commands, or a review or test agent running in CI (Continuous Integration).
Security habits around agents: forbidden patterns, least privilege on the tools and credentials an agent can reach, secrets kept out of AI context, AI-suggested packages verified before they are merged.
Test and debugging depth with AI: coverage gap analysis, regression tests written from production incidents, root-cause work using observability data.
LLM work: prompt engineering, agent SDKs, or orchestration frameworks such as Strands Agents, LangChain or LlamaIndex.
Agentic patterns beyond the basics: RAG, MCP, skills, hooks, plugins.
Experience designing scalable, highly available systems, ideally in Go.
Curiosity about how these systems actually work under the hood: benchmarking them, breaking them, improving them.
On seniority
We are open on seniority. Mid-level and senior candidates are both evaluated, and your level comes from what you have shipped, not from the number on your CV. The one thing we do not flex on: agents are already how you work, not something you are planning to try.
What We Offer
Enjoy a monthly meal allowance designed to enhance your daily routine
Access comprehensive private health insurance
Find your people with yoga classes, running and cycling clubs, and nutrition workshops
Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, Neoskola, and CloudGuru
Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills
Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together
Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build
Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses
Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects
From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories
We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.
Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!
