title: AI Content Specialist
description:
About Firework
Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact
Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.
We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.
Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.
If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.
Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented AI Content Specialist to support the creation, review, quality assurance, and delivery of AI-generated content for our customers. This role will play a critical part in ensuring that AI-generated images and videos meet our standards for product accuracy, visual realism, voice quality, brand presentation, creativity, and overall customer readiness.
The ideal candidate has a strong eye for detail, is comfortable working with AI-powered content generation tools, and can consistently evaluate content against established quality standards. This person will manage images and videos throughout the content production and review workflow, maintain accurate tracking in our project management platform, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality content is delivered efficiently and at scale.
What you’ll be doing
Create and review AI-generated images and videos against established quality and content standards before they are released to customers
Evaluate content for product accuracy, ensuring that products, product details, features, colors, dimensions, branding, and other relevant information are represented correctly
Assess visual realism and quality, identifying AI artifacts, unnatural movement, visual inconsistencies, distorted products or people, rendering issues, and other quality concerns
Evaluate AI-generated voice quality, including pronunciation, pacing, tone, clarity, synchronization, and naturalness
Review scripts, on-screen text, captions, product claims, and other content for accuracy and consistency with the source Identify issues requiring regeneration or correction and clearly document feedback to support efficient resolution
Conduct multiple rounds of quality assurance to ensure content meet internal standards before final publication
Maintain accurate, real-time tracking of all deliverables and their production status in project management tools
Track and document each piece of content throughout the full production lifecycle, including generation, initial review, revisions, upload, final quality review, publication, and assignment to the appropriate client playlist
Maintain organized records of quality issues, revisions, approvals, and completed content
Help ensure content production goals, deadlines, and client delivery expectations are met
Attend and actively participate in daily stand-up meetings to provide updates on content production progress, quality issues, blockers, and priorities
We’ll be excited if you have
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle visual, audio, and content-quality issues
Strong judgment when evaluating whether AI-generated content meets established quality standards
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage and track a high volume of content simultaneously
Comfortable learning and working across multiple internal platforms and AI tools
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a fast-moving, cross-functional environment
Previous experience is not required; however, experience in content quality assurance, content operations, content production, e-commerce content, digital media, or AI-generated content is valued and considered a plus
Compensation
Additional Information
Locations
This is a fully remote position, and we are seeking candidates based in the Philippines who are able to work hours aligned with the U.S. Pacific Time (PT) zone.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenAPI
description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.
What we offer
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration.
Developer Growth owns the surfaces developers and their agents use: our SDKs, API, documentation and ElevenAPI dashboard. This role focuses on the dashboard and product flows, helping self-serve and enterprise developers get started, understand their usage and get more value from ElevenLabs.
You will join a small, remote team and own features across frontend and backend. You will use direct user feedback and experiments to decide what to build, combining strong engineering with a careful eye for developer experience.
Your responsibilities will include:
Improving the ElevenAPI dashboard so developers can manage integrations and understand how their applications and agents use ElevenLabs.
Streamlining onboarding, helping developers create API keys, get started with agents and reach their first successful integration.
Designing and shipping experiments to improve activation, API key creation and self-serve subscriptions, then using the results to guide further changes.
Owning features from discovery and design through frontend, backend, deployment and iteration, working closely with the team and learning from users.
There is scope to grow into technical and team leadership over time, depending on your experience and impact.
Requirements
Strong full-stack engineering skills, with particular strength in frontend development and confidence building backend services and APIs.
Strong product judgement and attention to UX, with evidence of making complex workflows intuitive for developers.
Experience using user feedback, product data and experimentation to prioritise work and improve measurable outcomes.
Independent, end-to-end ownership, clear communication and genuine enthusiasm for developer tools and developer experience.
Experience managing or mentoring a small team of software engineers
Prior generative audio experience is not required. Experience building developer-facing products, API dashboards or onboarding flows is particularly valuable. Previous technical or team leadership experience is a plus.
Location:
This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.
#LI-Remote
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
About Upstart
At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.
As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.
We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.
If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
The Team
Upstart’s Partnerships team helps drive customer acquisition and originations through partner offers. The team is focused on improving how offers are optimized across the customer journey.
As the Applied Scientist on the Partnerships team, you’ll use causal inference, experimentation, and machine learning to help determine which offers are most likely to support customer conversion. You’ll take on a greenfield optimization opportunity, moving from research and measurement to production-ready models and decision strategies.
How you’ll make an impact
Develop causal machine-learning models to optimize customer offers at different points in the funnel, from marketing-time decisions with limited information to decisions informed by customer activity on our site.
Analyze and interpret complex data, identify gaps in what we know, and design experiments to gather evidence for building and evaluating optimization models.
Measure the impact of offer changes with statistically rigorous experiments and evaluations.
Translate research and results into clear recommendations, decision strategies, and next steps for business and technical partners.
Build production-ready models and code for use in offer selection.
Partner with Partnerships leadership, Product, Engineering, peer machine-learning teams, and model-risk partners to align on strategy, implementation, and methodology.
Minimum Qualifications
Graduate degree in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
2+ years of experience conducting machine-learning, statistical-modeling, or applied quantitative research in an academic or industry setting.
Experience applying causal inference methods and experimentation to real-world decisions in an applied-science or data-science context.
Applied statistics, probability, and experimental-design expertise used to build or evaluate models or interventions.
Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.
Preferred Qualifications
PhD in a quantitative field.
Experience with marketplace optimization, particularly where pricing or offer decisions are central.
Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.
Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.
Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production-model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.
Ability to translate broad business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.
Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote
Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
About Quilter
At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.
No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:
Curiosity
Conviction
Rigor
Quilter is looking for Senior to Staff Applied Scientists and Software Engineers to help invent the next generation of automated PCB design. You'll design, implement and test state-of-the-art algorithms for some of the hardest problems in computational geometry, optimization, high-performance computing and physics simulation. As a senior member of the team, you'll help shape the technical roadmap, mentor your peers and build the foundation for superhuman PCB design.
You'll work on one or more parts of the system, such as core learning algorithms, differential geometry techniques, state-of-the-art optimization methods, CPU and GPU backend performance, and fast physics simulation.
What You’ll Do
Drive applied research toward the next breakthrough in PCB design.
Architect, implement and test high-performance libraries in Python, C++, Mojo, TypeScript, etc.
Lead by example: mentor engineers, give technical reviews and help raise the team's engineering practices.
What We’re Looking For
3 to 10+ years of industry experience maintaining and extending large, high-performance codebases in collaborative environments.
A strong academic background in applied mathematics, with deep expertise in one or more of: optimization, machine learning, computational geometry, graph theory, high-performance computing (HPC), meshing, numerical methods, physics simulation, or a related field.
Proficiency in Python for prototyping and for integrating with ML systems.
Strong leadership skills: ownership, hiring and mentoring, sound decision-making and clear communication.
Nice to Have
An advanced degree (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) in computer science, computational physics, robotics or a related field.
Expertise in GPU optimization and parallel or distributed algorithms.
Experience with reinforcement learning, CAD/EDA tools or physics-based optimization.
Contributions to open-source geometry, simulation or HPC projects.
Knowledge of physics engines, finite element methods (FEM) or distributed computing.
Please note: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent.
What we offer:
Interesting and challenging work
Competitive salary and equity benefits
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Regular team events and offsites (~4x / year)
Unlimited paid time off
Paid parental leave

title: Site Reliability Engineer

Building the Backbone of Distributed Applications.
At Orkes, we are reimagining how developers build reliable, scalable, event-driven applications without wrangling complex infrastructure.
Born from Netflix's battle-tested open-source project, OSS Conductor, our platform is now powering billions of mission critical workflows across fintech, e-commerce, logistics, healthcare, and more.
Our platform powers billions of mission critical workflows across industries like fintech, e-commerce, logistics, and healthcare helping companies run the core operations of their business with confidence. These are the workflows behind every transaction, every delivery, every patient check-in, quietly orchestrating our digital world.
We’re solving some of the hardest infrastructure problems: how do you make distributed systems reliable, observable, and scalable – without every team having to reinvent the wheel? We absorb the complexity of distributed systems, letting teams build with confidence.

title: Research Scientist, Real-Time Video Generation
description:
About Cantina
Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.
If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!
About the Role
We’re working on real-time video generation for interactive characters, spanning realistic humans, stylized characters, and non-human identities. We want these characters to feel present: to speak, react, and express themselves through their face, gestures, and body language.
This brings together a set of closely connected research problems. A character needs a consistent appearance, expressive and coherent motion, and a natural relationship between speech and movement. The model also needs to respond quickly and keep generating reliably as an interaction unfolds. Quality, controllability, and efficiency all matter.
You’ll work across streaming generation, fine-tuning, distillation, inference optimization, and data. Some problems will call for a new training approach; others will come down to better examples, a more useful evaluation, or understanding a bottleneck in the implementation. Part of the job is figuring out which intervention is worth making.
You’ll have substantial freedom to propose directions, investigate unfamiliar ideas, and shape what we work on next. We’re looking for someone who enjoys that freedom and can turn it into a steady sequence of useful experiments.
What You’ll Work On
Real-time and streaming generation. Develop models that support responsive interaction while maintaining visual quality and consistency over time. Investigate latency, continuity, and how model behavior changes during longer generation.
Character expression and motion. Explore how appearance, facial expression, gesture, and body movement come together into a coherent character. Improve the relationship between speech and motion across different identities and visual styles.
Fine-tuning and post-training. Adapt video models to new data, behaviors, and capabilities. Investigate training objectives and conditioning methods, and follow promising ideas through implementation and evaluation.
Distillation and inference optimization. Make generation faster and more efficient. Work across model-level approaches and runtime improvements, measuring their effects on quality, latency, and memory.
Data development. Spend meaningful time with the actual training examples. Identify missing coverage and recurring failure modes, improve curation and sampling, and develop data that helps models learn the behavior we want.
Evaluation. Build comparisons that make progress visible and failures understandable. Combine quantitative measurements with careful inspection of generated video and the experience of interacting with the model.
Research and collaboration. Read relevant work, reproduce and adapt useful ideas, and share early experiments, demos, and findings. Help the team decide what deserves more time and compute.
What You’ll Bring
Experience training or fine-tuning video or related generative models.
Ability to learn unfamiliar methods quickly and turn ideas into useful experiments.
Good experimental judgment, ownership, and clear communication.
You’ll have freedom to explore new approaches. We expect fast iteration and early sharing of results.

title: Software Engineer - Console
description:
About XBOW
Build the future of offensive security with XBOW. Attackers are already using AI to move faster than defenders can react—we’re creating the platform that puts security ahead in the arms race. Our AI-powered system autonomously discovers, validates, and even exploits vulnerabilities, giving organizations proof-backed results in hours instead of weeks.

We’re a team of builders, hackers, and researchers who thrive on solving problems others think are impossible. If you want to push the boundaries of AI, reshape how security is done, and join the group defining this new era of defense — we’d love to talk.

What You'll Do

Own problems end-to-end—from design through deployment to production support

Experience building and operating full-stack systems

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with incomplete information

What We Offer

title: Content Engineer, Developer Relations
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
Position Summary
This role exists to evangelize the Harness AI platform, not by describing what it does, but by using it. You'll design practical use cases that show what a specific Harness capability actually solves for a practitioner, build that use case yourself inside the platform, and turn it into content that lets other practitioners design and execute the same thing on their own.
Video is part of the job, but it's the part we can coach. Our team can teach you how to run a shoot and cut a piece the way the best technical demo producers at developer-obsessed companies do it. The must-have skill is technical judgment, i.e., knowing which use case is worth building, where the real friction is, and how to demonstrate it credibly to someone who'd see through a scripted demo in five seconds. That has to be there on day one.
About the role
Design practical, realistic use cases inside Harness: the kind of problem a developer, a platform engineer, or a DevOps lead actually has, and build them yourself, end to end, inside the product
Run your own shoots (remote or in-person) with technical practitioners, including our Field CTOs: you operate the capture, not just receive footage from someone else
Produce technical content around each use case: concept, execution, and final piece are all yours, start to finish, across video and writing
Evangelize specific Harness AI capabilities (CI, CD, IDP, security, AI cost) in ways that map directly onto a practitioner's real workflow, not a feature list
Partner with our production team to sharpen craft: pacing, visual packaging, delivery, while owning the technical substance yourself
Pitch and pilot new formats and hooks on your own initiative
Let performance data steer what you build next: watch time and returning viewers tell you which use cases and capabilities are actually resonating, not a fixed calendar alone
Cross-functional partnership: You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and the Field CTOs to source real use cases, and with Product Marketing to keep messaging aligned, but the execution and editorial judgment are yours.
About you
Deep, hands-on fluency with Harness or a comparable CI/CD, IDP, or DevOps platform: Familiarity with the broader DevOps/platform engineering space: GitOps, progressive delivery, SAST/SCA, DORA metrics, enough to design a use case from a blank slate and build it yourself, not follow someone else's script
A portfolio of technical content you've personally produced: concept, execution, and camera/edit, not just cut from footage someone else designed and shot. Links, not a reel.
Comfort operating your own recording setup, remote or in-person, with technical practitioners who are not professional presenters
The instincts of a practitioner: you think about a problem the way the person you're filming or the person you’re creating the content for does, and you can tell the difference between a demo that's honest about friction and one that's just polished
Self-directed and productive: you don't wait for a brief. You spot the use case, build it, film it, and know what's worth keeping
Genuinely creative about capturing developer attention: you have your own ideas about what makes a technical audience stop scrolling and actually watch, and you'll push for the weird format or unconventional angle when the standard playbook feels stale, not just execute the four formats we've already defined
Nice to have:
Engineering background: people who can write code well enough to have opinions about it, and have since moved towards explaining and teaching it.
Existing video/production craft (framing, pacing, basic edit). We'll build on this, not require it on day one
A personal or team technical content channel you've grown yourself
What This Role Is Not
Worth being direct about this. This is not a video editing job. If your strongest skill is post-production and your technical depth is "I can follow along," this isn't the right fit. We can teach editing; we can't teach technical judgment. It's also not a role where someone else designs the demo, and you just point a camera at it. You're expected to find the use case, not just capture it.
What Success Looks Like in 90 Days
2–3 original use cases you designed and built yourself inside Harness, each turned into a piece of content
A recording workflow you run independently, no one else needs to be behind the camera for you to ship
Early signal (watch time, returning viewers) on which use cases and capabilities are actually resonating with practitioners
A clear, credible point of view, in the content itself, on what a specific Harness capability solves and how a practitioner would actually use it
Work Location
Remote within the U.S
What you will have at Harness
Competitive salary
Comprehensive healthcare benefits
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Flexible work schedule
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
Monthly internet reimbursement

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. The compensation package for this position may also include equity, and benefits. More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.harness.io/company/careers.
Pay transparency
$150,000—$162,000 USD

Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. title: Software Engineer, Data Integration
description:
Software Engineer, Data Integration
In Brief
We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.
Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.
Who We Are
Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.
We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.
Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.
What you’ll do
You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.
Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened.
Responsibilities
Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes.
Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.
Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.
Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort.
Minimum qualifications
BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred)
Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources.
Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment
Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems
Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR.
Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues
Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.
Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

title: eLearning Developer, Articulate Rise Contractor
description:

You will also serve as a delivery adviser for new courses, reviewing full content packages and recommending the best way to bring them to life online. Course Audits:
Take each course from the learner’s perspective and evaluate structure, pacing, engagement, assessment, accessibility, and overall learner experience
Deliver findings and recommendations document for each course using the provided template, with prioritized, practical recommendations a non-designer can act on
Flag outdated content, inconsistencies, and gaps against current CrossFit methodology and brand standards for subject-matter review
Recommend whether each course needs targeted updates or a full rebuild, with an estimate of effort
Course Updates and Rebuilds:
Update existing Rise 360 builds or rebuild courses from scratch based on approved recommendations
Design interactions, knowledge checks, scenarios, and assessments that reinforce learning and connect directly to real coaching practice
Integrate video, graphics, and other media effectively, and identify new asset needs for the team
Build courses that meet accessibility standards and perform well on desktop and mobile
Test published courses in the learning management system to confirm tracking, completion, and credit reporting work as intended
New Course Design:
Review full content packages for new courses and recommend the best delivery approach, including structure, sequencing, interactivity, media, and assessment strategy
Turn subject-matter expert content into clear, engaging online learning, and identify where content needs to be added, cut, or reworked
Build new courses in Rise 360 as the catalog grows
Localization Readiness:
Build courses with translation in mind, keeping text, media, and interactions easy to localize
Prepare courses for the localization workflow and support the team as translated versions are implemented and reviewed
Standards and Collaboration:
Collaborate with the EDU Content team to keep courses aligned with CrossFit methodology, voice, and brand standards
Create or refine reusable templates, build standards, and style guidelines so the course library delivers a consistent look and learner experience
Incorporate feedback from reviewers and stakeholders through iterative review cycles
Manage your own timeline across multiple courses, report progress regularly, and flag risks early
Knowledge and Skills
Deep grounding in adult learning principles and instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM, Merrill’s Principles of Instruction, Bloom’s taxonomy)
Advanced and current, hands-on Articulate Rise 360 skills, including blocks, interactions, quizzes, Storyline blocks, and creative design within Rise’s constraints
Experience auditing and redesigning existing courses, not only building new ones
Strong assessment design skills, including scenario-based questions and knowledge checks that measure application, not recall
Clear, practical written recommendations a non-designer can act on
Working knowledge of accessibility standards and SCORM publishing to a learning management system
Self-directed and organized, with a reliable record of meeting deadlines in a remote, part-time contract setting
Familiarity with fitness, coaching, or certification-based education is a plus; CrossFit Level 1 Certificate a plus
Experience with Articulate Storyline 360, video editing, or localization workflows is a plus
Education/Experience
Five or more years of instructional design experience
Minimum three years of hands-on Articulate Rise 360 experience, within the past three years
Portfolio of live Rise 360 builds required with application

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.
We’re seeking an Intermediate Developer with a full-stack or backend-focused background to join our Enterprise Tenants and Policies team,
This team focuses on the B2B side of our Enterprise Password Manager. We build features that help large organizations manage 1Password at scale. Our team focuses on multi-tenancy and linked accounts, policies that give businesses control over how 1Password operates across their organizations, and intuitive admin experiences for managing groups, teams, and other configurations. As we continue moving from a monolithic application toward a microservice architecture, you’ll help evolve our policy services and build enterprise features that work across multiple services and codebases.
How we’re using AI today
Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

What we're looking for:
You have 2+ years of experience in software development

A drive for and proven experience in software development best practices and coding standards
You enjoy solving moderately complex problems and have demonstrated an ability to propose effective solutions

Write comprehensive tests during various stages of the development cycle, ensuring code functions as expected
Review code for others to maintain high code quality, share knowledge within the team, and support a safe environment for giving and receiving feedback
Generate and review documentation on code and development processes to ensure scalability
Stay informed about the latest industry trends, technologies, and development best practices
Be available for on-call rotational work to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve emergencies
USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $123,000 USD and $172,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. title: Data Scientist II (Soccer)
description:
We're hiring a Data Scientist II on our Soccer team to develop the statistical and machine learning models our partner clubs use for player recruitment. I'm Jacob Mortensen, Senior Manager, Data Science at Teamworks. Our team primarily focuses on building models using both player tracking data and event data to identify undervalued players and characterize the skills that make them effective. The work supports high-stakes recruitment decisions for professional clubs across global football.
The team is managing growing demand from partner clubs alongside model maintenance and new development. This hire will take ownership across the model lifecycle, from design and validation through deployment and improvement. That added capacity will help us move important initiatives forward while keeping our existing models accurate and reliable.
The Role
3+ years of professional or research experience developing statistical or machine learning models in Python or R, with examples of work you personally owned from problem formulation and data preparation through validation and use
Strong applied statistical and modeling judgment: you can select appropriate methods, explain their assumptions and trade-offs, and distinguish meaningful predictive signal from artifacts in the data
Experience designing rigorous model evaluations, including preventing data leakage, choosing validation strategies appropriate to temporal or grouped data, quantifying uncertainty, and assessing performance across relevant player populations and contexts
Experience building models with sports tracking data, including working with spatial and temporal relationships, noisy or incomplete observations, and the data-quality challenges that affect model reliability
Ability to write maintainable, tested, and reproducible analytical code, using version control and code review to support collaborative development
Proficiency in SQL to join, transform, and validate large, structured datasets used in model development
Experience taking models beyond exploratory notebooks into repeatable workflows or production systems, collaborating with engineering and investigating issues as models are used
Ability to explain modeling decisions, limitations, and results clearly to technical teammates and professional soccer clubs
What I'm Looking For
What You Must Bring
3+ years of professional or research experience writing code in R or Python for data science, statistics, or machine learning work
Comfort with SQL for building and querying structured data
Strong data science fundamentals: you understand how models work, what they need from the data, and how to set data up to support them
Experience working with sports tracking data, including understanding the kinds of models typically built and the data challenges that come with them
Strong communication skills — you'll be explaining modeling decisions directly to partner clubs, not just internal teammates
Even Better If
You have direct experience with soccer data or soccer analytics (inside a team, public work, or academically)
You have a demonstrated track record of tackling hard problems through published research, blog posts, conference talks, or public projects
Experience using a cloud compute provider (e.g. AWS or Google Cloud) to train and deploy models
Comfort using AI coding tools, paired with the judgment to recognize when their output needs to be questioned or corrected
Why This Role
Soccer analytics is moving quickly, and this team is helping shape how advanced modeling is used in recruitment. You'll have meaningful ownership, room to develop new approaches, and the opportunity to see your work used by professional clubs. You'll also help define how the team builds, maintains, and scales its model portfolio as demand grows.
This role is not eligible for sponsorship at this time.
Please submit your application through this posting only. We're unable to review applications or resumes sent via email, LinkedIn, or other channels.

We're the Operating System for Sports™, powering 7,000+ organizations worldwide, from collegiate programs to every major pro league. Founded in 2006, we've evolved from a messaging tool for college football into the leading sports tech platform, with 600+ global teammates building the future of sports tech. Our solutions span Personnel, Coaching, Performance, Operations, and Intelligence - helping teams recruit smarter, train better, stay compliant, and win.

title: LLM Applied Data Scientist (RAG/ NLP)
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled Research Scientist/Engineer to advance the reasoning and planning capabilities of large foundation models. In this role, you will enhance model performance across the entire development lifecycle—including data acquisition, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward modelling, and reinforcement learning—while driving innovations in reasoning and decision-making. You will synthesise large-scale, high-quality datasets through rewriting, augmentation, and generation techniques to strengthen foundation models during pretraining, SFT, and RL stages. A key part of the role involves solving complex tasks using System 2 thinking and applying advanced decoding strategies such as MCTS and A*. You will design and implement robust evaluation methodologies, teach models to interact with external tools, APIs, and code interpreters, and build agents and multi-agent systems capable of addressing sophisticated real-world problems.
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize data processing and retrieval pipelines for enterprise-level generative tasks and mode training applications (Customer Service, Token Report, Web3 Domain Models). This includes embedding, reranking, context engineering, and query rewriting models.
Research and evaluate advanced AI-native retrieval algorithms (e.g., low-latency, multimodal retrieval, hierarchical retrieval, GraphRAG) to strengthen large-scale LLM/VLM/Agentic AI capabilities in Binance products.
Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to integrate RAG pipelines into production systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and measurable business impact.
Develop and optimize retrieval and ranking pipelines (indexing, vector search, retrieval scoring, reranking) to improve user experience.
Participate in LLM training and RAG system, staying current with techniques such as pre-training, SFT, and reinforcement learning, and apply them to retrieval and generation tasks.
Apply NLP, CV, and multimodal methods to analyze user-generated content (classification, quality evaluation, trend detection, comment analysis).
Requirement
Master’s in Information Retrieval, NLP, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Multimodal Learning, or related fields.
Proficient in PyTorch with strong coding skills in Python or C++.
Strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and passion for lifelong learning. Able to identify opportunities and drive cutting-edge retrieval & RAG technologies into real-world applications.
Solid theoretical foundation in information retrieval, NLP, and deep learning (experience with embeddings, reranking, query understanding preferred).
Hands-on experience with RAG, vector databases, multimodal/graph retrieval, or large-scale AI systems.
Strong engineering ability to translate research into scalable, production-level systems.
Self-driven, able to own projects end-to-end (design → implementation → deployment).
Publications in top-tier conferences/journals (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, CVPR, SIGIR, KDD, WWW) are a plus; awards in ACM/ICPC or similar competitions preferred.
Why Binance
Shape the future of finance
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Competitive salary and company benefits
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Surface hard to find intelligence, such as contact center scale, BPO footprint, and tech stack

Entrepreneur mindset with strong ownership and bias to build

title: DevOps Engineer (Observability)
description:
Who we are
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.
Hiring and how we work
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.
See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as our next Software Engineer on Twilio’s platform engineering observability team.
About the job
This position is needed to help our platform engineering observability team. Twilio is undergoing a large-scale observability transformation—and you can help shape the foundation. Observability is a strategic pillar and a key enabler for faster incident response, deeper customer-centric insights, and more cost-effective platform operations.
As a Software Engineer on the Platform Observability team, you’ll play a critical role in re-architecting how telemetry flows and is utilized through Twilio—making it structured, accessible, affordable, and actionable. Over the next 3 years, Twilio is rebuilding nearly every component of our observability platform, from data collection to real-time analytics. You will drive core initiatives that shift Twilio from fragmented tooling and wasteful data sprawl to a unified, OpenTelemetry-first observability stack built for scale.
You’ll lead technically and strategically—designing platform components, influencing org-wide architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and engaging directly with teams across Platform Engineering and R&D
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:
Lead the end-to-end architecture and delivery of key observability platform components, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and usability.
Drive consistency and quality across all observability signals—logs, metrics, traces, and continuous profiling—building intuitive workflows for engineers.
Serve as a technical advisor and mentor across the platform org, guiding design decisions and aligning cross-team efforts with long-term architectural goals.
Go deep in one or more problem areas (e.g., high-cardinality telemetry, distributed tracing correlation, compute cost insights), while ensuring the platform scales horizontally.
Collaborate with product teams, SREs, and developer experience groups to deeply understand telemetry needs and integrate observability into core engineering workflows.
Design and build developer-friendly tooling and APIs to support incident response, performance analysis, and platform debugging at scale.
Leverage (and optionally contribute to) open-source standards like OpenTelemetry to ensure interoperability and extensibility.
Champion a pragmatic approach to observability—balancing performance, cost, and user value across diverse engineering teams.
Qualifications

title: Data Scientist, AI/ML
description:
Data Scientist, AI/ML
Job Description:
Today’s complex, fast-paced systems have become a minefield of reliability risks, any of which could cause an outage that costs millions and destroys customer confidence. That’s why high-availability teams use Gremlin to find and fix reliability risks before they become incidents.
Gremlin Reliability Platform helps software teams proactively monitor and test their systems for common reliability risks, build and enforce reliability standards, and automate their reliability practices organization-wide. As the industry leader in Chaos Engineering and reliability testing, we work with hundreds of the world’s largest organizations where high availability is non-negotiable.
About the Role of the Data Scientist, AI/ML
As a Data Scientist, AI/ML at Gremlin, you will have the opportunity to improve the reliability of the internet at large by turning millions of chaos engineering experiments into automated failure analysis and remediation. You will be able to leverage your applied machine learning experience to inform product direction as well as solve complex technical problems that directly impact our customers (which range from the Fortune 500 to smaller organizations). You will work closely with a small, talented engineering team focused on quality, delivery, and predictability with an emphasis on providing our customers a great user experience.
In this role, you’ll get to:
Analyze Gremlin’s proprietary dataset of millions of chaos engineering experiments to identify failure patterns, root causes, and resilience signals across complex distributed systems
Pretraining and fine-tuning machine learning models that automatically detect, classify, and explain failures observed during chaos experiments
Build intelligent systems that deliver automated remediation recommendations, and eventually orchestration, by learning from historical experiment outcomes and system behavior
Develop scalable data pipelines and feature stores to process, enrich, and serve large volumes of experiment data for both model training and real-time inference
Collaborate closely with platform engineers and SREs to integrate AI-driven failure analysis and remediation capabilities directly into Gremlin’s core product
Apply advanced techniques, including causal inference, graph ML, time-series modeling, and reinforcement learning, to continuously improve the accuracy and actionability of automated failure analysis
Translate insights from millions of chaos experiments into AI-powered features that help customers automatically understand blast radius, pinpoint root causes, and accelerate recovery
Research and productionize novel ML approaches, including causal AI and agentic systems, that turn raw chaos experiment data into automated, reliable remediation strategies
We’ll expect you to have:
Experience as a self-driven and collaborative problem solver with strong communication skills
5+ years professional experience building and productionizing machine learning, ideally for distributed systems, infrastructure, or DevOps and SRE use cases with more overall years of experience in software development.
Hands-on experience with techniques such as causal inference, graph ML, time-series modeling, or reinforcement learning
Experience building data pipelines and feature stores that support both offline training and real-time inference
Experience with agile development environments and practices
Strong advocate and practitioner of rigorous experimentation, model evaluation, and engineering best practices
Comfort partnering with platform engineers and SREs to turn research into shipped product features
Strong at breaking down ambiguous problems into concrete actions and milestones
Bonus Experience:
Experience with chaos engineering, site reliability engineering, or distributed systems
Background in agentic AI systems or large-scale causal inference in production
Experience standing up MLOps tooling such as model serving, monitoring, or feature store infrastructure
Working in Remote first environments
Has been on-call and participated in an incident management program
*The role does not offer sponsorship employment benefits.
**If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria above but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
Compensation
We expect the salary range for this role to be $220,000 - $290,000. We recognize that salary varies from person to person depending on level of experience and we welcome direct conversations about it. The final offer will vary based on assessment of a candidate's skills and ability and our budget and market data.
Gremlin offers competitive total compensation packages including 401k Matching, Equity and other benefits such as flexible time off and paid company holidays.
About Gremlin:
Gremlin is a team of industry veterans and people eager to learn from one another. We set the standard for reliability and equip leading organizations with the mindset and expertise needed to drive reliability improvements that move the world forward. We’re backed by top-tier investors Index Ventures, Amplify Partners, and Redpoint Ventures. Our customers love us, and we’re thrilled to be a partner in their success.
What Do We Care About:
We Care about our People
People are our critical differentiators. The company strives to treat our people with respect, empathy, and dignity. We expect that our people will treat each other similarly. In both cases, we will assume good intent. All are welcome at Gremlin. We know our differences make us stronger and that our best ideas and contributions can come from anyone at any level.
We Care about Collaboration
Gremlin is strongest when we come together as one team with shared goals. Be the glue, not the glitter. But as a remote company, teamwork and collaboration won’t happen by accident. We approach every challenge as a shared challenge. We rely on each other for diverse perspectives and creative ideas. We celebrate our wins as a team.
We Care about Results
Be high productivity, low drama. Results matter. To keep our pace, everyone owns the outcomes of their actions and takes action when needed. We reward speed over perfection. We empower each other to iterate and experiment. You are welcome at Gremlin for who you are. The more voices and ideas we have represented in our business, the more we will all flourish, contribute, and build a more reliable internet.
Gremlin is a place where everyone can grow and is encouraged. However you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to come into work everyday. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep building a more reliable internet by building and designing tools used by the best companies in the world.
Visit our website to learn more - https://www.gremlin.com/about

Brunswick is on an exciting journey to harness the power of artificial intelligence and data science to enhance the way we work and the advice we provide to clients. As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining AI-powered applications that deliver real value across the business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications who enjoys solving complex problems, working with a high degree of autonomy, and turning emerging technologies into practical, high-quality products.

You will thrive in this role if you are curious, creative, and passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. You take pride in writing robust, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to continuously improve and expand our AI capabilities.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Support, run, and iterate existing AI applications.
  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain new AI applications which can be scaled across multiple business use cases, driving operational and commercial outcomes.
  • Trial and test solutions with end users to iterate and optimise them.

  • Track and understand the evolving AI landscape.

They will have a strong academic background complemented by an outstanding career to date. Standout candidates will demonstrate:

  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
  • A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.
In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.
This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.
What you'll do
Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.
Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.
Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.
Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.
Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.
What we're looking for
You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).
You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.
Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.
You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.
Bonus
Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies
Information extraction or truth discovery at scale
Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats
Example projects
Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

title: AI Builder
description:
The short version
Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.
As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.
We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.
What Contentoo does
Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.
None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.
There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.
What you'll do
A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.
In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.
The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.
What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.
The team
You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.
Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it.
Who you are
You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:
Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.
You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.
Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.
You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it.
Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.
If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place.
What you’ll get
A competitive salary based on experience
25 vacation days per year
Pension contribution
Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility)
A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders
Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)
A monthly Alleo budget
A learning budget
Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!
A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more
Why Contentoo, why now
You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week.
The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero.
The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet.
What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them.
Sounds interesting?
Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)
