Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.

Why this role exists

Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.

This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.

The role

As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.

You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.

Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.

What you will do

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.
  • Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.
  • Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.
  • Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.
  • Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.
  • Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.
  • Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.
  • At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.

Who you are

  • A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.
  • A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.
  • Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.
  • Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.
  • Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.
  • Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
  • Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.
  • Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.
  • Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.

What you’ll need

The basics

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.
  • Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.
  • Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.
  • Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.
  • Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.
  • Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent professional English.
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.
  • Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.
  • Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.
  • Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Dutch.

In return, this is what we offer

You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.

Our compensation

  • A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.

Our culture

title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
description:
Who We Are
You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.
We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.
Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.
Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.
Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.
Who we're looking for
We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.
What you'll do
GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:
Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation
Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management
Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting
Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments
Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving
Deployment & Serving:
Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks
Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions
ML Acceleration:
Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks
Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile
Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts
Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short
Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains
Enablement & Best Practices:
Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default
Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption
Minimum qualifications
5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads
Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures
Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM
Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost
Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)
Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements
Preferred qualifications
Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention
Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed
Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment
Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis
Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation
Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton
What we offer
Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO
State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end
Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure
Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy
Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment
Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations
Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning
If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.
Why Prosus?
At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.
Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.
Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.
Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment
We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

title: Quantum Applications and Data Engineer – Quantum AI/ML & Hybrid Computing
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking a Quantum Applications and Data Engineer to design, implement, and evaluate quantum computing applications, quantum AI/ML models, and hybrid quantum–classical workflows.
The successful candidate will translate selected business and research problems into practical experiments, develop proof-of-concept solutions, and assess their performance against appropriate classical approaches. The role also includes dedicated data engineering responsibilities to ensure reliable data preparation, automated processing, and reproducible experimentation.
This position requires strong Python programming skills, a foundation in machine learning and quantum computing, and the ability to communicate experimental findings clearly.
Key Responsibilities
1. Quantum AI and Machine Learning
Develop and evaluate quantum machine learning prototypes for selected classification, regression, and clustering use cases.
Implement and assess quantum feature maps, quantum kernels, and parameterized quantum circuits.
Explore variational quantum classifiers and hybrid quantum–classical learning architectures.
Prepare suitable data-encoding strategies for quantum machine learning experiments.
Integrate quantum model components with classical machine learning tools and workflows.
Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics, consistent datasets, and reproducible methods.
Document training behavior, experimental results, resource requirements, and limitations.
2. Quantum Programming and Application Development
Design, implement, test, and maintain quantum circuits using frameworks such as Qiskit or PennyLane.
Develop reusable Python components for circuit construction, execution, and results analysis.
Implement selected quantum algorithms within clearly defined proof-of-concept projects.
Execute experiments using quantum simulators and, where available, cloud-accessible quantum hardware.
Analyze the effects of circuit design, measurement strategies, and execution conditions.
Maintain version-controlled source code, test cases, and technical documentation.
3. Hybrid Quantum–Classical Workflows
Develop workflows connecting classical data processing, quantum computation, and results interpretation.
Implement iterative optimization workflows involving parameterized circuits and classical optimizers.
Integrate quantum experiments with Python-based AI/Libraries.
Automate experiment configuration, execution, monitoring, and output collection.
Develop prototypes for selected machine learning and optimization problems.
Identify integration constraints and document technical trade-offs.
4. Quantum Experimentation, Benchmarking and Use-Case Assessment
Assess business and research requirements to identify suitable quantum computing experiments.
Define problem statements, assumptions, evaluation criteria, and experimental scope.
Develop or select classical reference implementations for comparison.
Benchmark experimental approaches using relevant measures, including predictive performance, execution time, and computational resources.
Investigate the effects of noise, sampling variability, and hardware limitations where applicable.
Review relevant technical literature and reproduce selected methods.
Present findings through technical reports, demonstrations, and stakeholder discussions.
Recommend whether to continue, revise, or discontinue an approach based on evidence, without presuming quantum advantage.
5. Data Engineering and Data Preparation
Develop and maintain Python and SQL workflows to ingest, clean, transform, and validate datasets.
Build lightweight ETL pipelines supporting quantum computing and AI/ML experiments.
Prepare consistent training, validation, and test datasets for classical and quantum model comparisons.
Implement checks for missing values, duplicates, inconsistent formats, and transformation errors.
Manage dataset versions, experiment inputs, configurations, and outputs.

title: Decision Support Data Scientist
company: HP PPS ASIA PACIFIC PTE. LTD.
description:
Job Description
JOB SUMMARY
HP is seeking a Decision Support Data Scientist to apply advanced analytics, statistical methods and decision science to complex supply chain planning problems.
The role will focus on translating planning challenges into structured analytical problems, diagnosing performance drivers, evaluating scenarios and trade-offs, and developing evidence-based recommendations that improve planning decisions.
This is a hands-on analytical role positioned between supply chain planning and technical data science. The successful candidate will work closely with Planning Decision Science leaders, planners, Data Scientists and Analytics Automation teams to turn data and analytical outputs into actionable business decisions.
The role is not primarily focused on production machine-learning engineering or dashboard development. Instead, it requires strong quantitative problem-solving skills and the ability to determine what the data means, evaluate alternative courses of action, quantify trade-offs and recommend what the business should do.
The successful candidate should be comfortable working with ambiguous business problems, large datasets and imperfect information, and should be able to communicate analytical conclusions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. DECISION SCIENCE & PROBLEM FRAMING
• Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous supply chain planning challenges into structured analytical problems.
• Define the decisions to be made, relevant objectives, constraints, assumptions, uncertainties and measures of success.
• Develop hypotheses and analytical approaches to investigate planning problems and identify underlying drivers.
• Determine the appropriate analytical methodology based on the business problem rather than applying predefined tools or techniques.
• Work with planning stakeholders to understand operational context and ensure analytical approaches reflect real-world business constraints.
2. DIAGNOSTIC & QUANTITATIVE ANALYTICS
• Analyse large and complex supply chain datasets using Python, SQL and statistical techniques.
• Conduct diagnostic and root-cause analyses across demand, supply, inventory, forecast performance and planning processes.
• Identify relationships, patterns and drivers that explain planning performance and business outcomes.
• Establish analytical baselines and compare performance across products, markets, segments and time horizons.
• Apply appropriate statistical methods to distinguish meaningful business signals from normal operational variation.
• Develop clear analytical narratives that explain what happened, why it happened and what actions should be considered.
3. SCENARIO ANALYSIS & DECISION SUPPORT
• Develop and evaluate planning scenarios to support decisions involving inventory, supply availability, demand uncertainty, cost, responsiveness and operational risk.
• Conduct what-if, sensitivity and trade-off analyses to evaluate alternative planning strategies.
• Quantify the expected benefits, risks and consequences associated with different courses of action.
• Evaluate decisions under uncertainty and identify assumptions or conditions that materially change the recommended action.
• Develop repeatable decision frameworks for recurring planning problems.
• Support planners and business leaders in understanding available options and making evidence-based decisions.
4. RECOMMENDATIONS & BUSINESS IMPACT
• Translate analytical findings into clear and actionable recommendations.
• Develop recommendations based on quantitative evidence, business constraints, uncertainty and trade-offs rather than reporting analytical results alone.
• Present scenarios, assumptions, alternatives, risks and expected outcomes clearly to business stakeholders.
• Work with Planning Decision Science leaders to challenge and refine recommendations before implementation.
• Track the outcomes of implemented recommendations and compare realised results against expected benefits.
• Use observed outcomes to improve future analytical approaches and decision frameworks.
5. DATA SCIENCE & ADVANCED ANALYTICS COLLABORATION
• Collaborate with Data Science teams developing forecasting, optimisation, simulation and predictive models.
• Translate planning and decision requirements into analytical and modelling requirements.
• Understand and critically evaluate model outputs, assumptions, limitations and business implications.
• Conduct business validation of model recommendations against operational constraints and planning objectives.
• Identify situations where predictive modelling, optimisation, simulation or other advanced analytical techniques could materially improve decision quality.
• Integrate outputs from technical models into broader business recommendations and decision frameworks.
• Partner with Data Scientists on experimentation and analytical prototypes where appropriate.
6. ANALYTICAL DEVELOPMENT
• Develop analytical solutions using Python, SQL and other quantitative tools.
• Build reusable analytical methodologies, scenario models and decision-support frameworks.
• Perform data preparation, feature analysis, statistical testing and exploratory modelling required to support planning decisions.
• Prototype analytical approaches before handing repeatable technical requirements to Data Science or Analytics Automation teams where appropriate.
• Collaborate with Analytics Automation teams to operationalise recurring analytical workflows into scalable tools, applications or automated processes.
• Maintain appropriate analytical documentation, assumptions and quality controls.
7. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION
• Work closely with regional and global supply chain planning stakeholders to understand business challenges and decision requirements.
• Collaborate across Planning Decision Science & Analytics, Data Science, Analytics Automation and Portfolio & Adoption teams.
• Communicate complex quantitative findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Challenge assumptions constructively and use evidence to influence planning decisions.
• Support continuous improvement of planning processes, analytical capabilities and decision-making practices.
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain Analytics, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline.
• Typically 4–7 years of relevant experience in data science, decision science, advanced analytics, operations research, supply chain analytics or another quantitative analytical function.
• Demonstrated experience independently analysing complex datasets and translating analytical findings into business recommendations.
• Experience structuring ambiguous business problems and determining appropriate analytical approaches.
• Strong quantitative and statistical problem-solving capabilities.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate alternatives, quantify trade-offs and communicate recommendations to business stakeholders.
TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Strong Python skills for data manipulation, statistical analysis and analytical modelling.
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets.
• Experience with Python analytical libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing and quantitative modelling.
• Experience with scenario modelling, sensitivity analysis or simulation.
• Understanding of predictive modelling and machine-learning concepts.
• Ability to interpret and critically evaluate model outputs rather than treating model predictions as deterministic answers.
• Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent.
• Familiarity with optimisation, operations research or mathematical modelling is advantageous.
• Experience with Git and modern analytical development practices is advantageous.
SUPPLY CHAIN / BUSINESS QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience applying analytics to business or operational decision-making.
• Supply chain planning experience is strongly preferred, particularly within demand planning, supply planning, inventory management or supply-demand balancing.
• Understanding of common planning trade-offs involving inventory, availability, service, cost, responsiveness and risk.
• Experience within technology, electronics, semiconductor, manufacturing or another complex global supply chain environment is advantageous.
• Familiarity with enterprise planning platforms such as SAP, Kinaxis, o9, Blue Yonder or equivalent is advantageous.
KEY COMPETENCIES
• Decision Science
• Structured Problem Solving
• Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
• Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis
• Trade-off Analysis
• Data Science
• Supply Chain Analytics
• Business Acumen
• Analytical Communication
• Critical Thinking
• Stakeholder Management
• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Learning Agility
ROLE BOUNDARY
The Decision Support Data Scientist owns analytical problem solving and supports the development of business recommendations.
The role is expected to answer questions such as:
• What is happening?
• Why is it happening?
• What decisions are available?
• What are the trade-offs between those decisions?
• How do uncertainty and changing assumptions affect the decision?
• What does the analytical evidence suggest we should do?
The role may develop analytical models and prototypes where required, but is not primarily accountable for production machine-learning engineering, enterprise data pipelines or application development.
Data Science teams provide specialised modelling, optimisation and technical capabilities where deeper technical development is required.
Analytics Automation teams provide scalable applications, data pipelines and workflow automation.
Planning Decision Science leadership integrates analytical evidence, business context and technical outputs into recommendations and supports planner decision-making and adoption.

title: Data Analyst [CCP-ICT Professionals]
description:
Role overview
We are hiring a full-time Data Analyst to turn our clients' portfolio and risk data into automated pipelines, analytics, dashboards andAI-assisted research. We are a software consultancy serving portfolio management and risk teams, and this role sits between our clients and our engineering work.
This is a career-conversion role. You do not need prior experience as a data analyst. You will learn the job through a structured 6-month on-the-job training programme under the Career Conversion Programme(CCP), working on real client deliverables from the first month.

Client needs and business analysis

Data engineering and automation
• Build connectors to broker, custodian and market datasources using REST APIs (authentication, JSON, paging, rate limits).
• Clean, map and load data into database, keeping field mapping documents and instrument mapping tables up to date.

Portfolio and risk analytics
• Calculate portfolio metrics: market value, weights, gross/net and long/short exposure, delta-adjusted exposure, concentration, and daily, cumulative and time-weighted returns.
• Calculate risk metrics: rolling volatility, correlation, beta, maximum drawdown, Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall, documenting each method's assumptions.
• Build stress scenarios (historical and hypothetical)and PnL attribution by asset, strategy and driver (price, carry/funding, FX, fees).
• Validate every metric against independent reference calculations and automate tests.

description:
Our Global Legal Project Management team is looking for an LPM Data Analyst to join our Asia team. Working closely with senior LPM colleagues and practice groups you will provide data-led insight and technology-enabled support on large, complex and multi-jurisdictional matters.
The successful LPM Data Analyst will prepare clear financial and operational reports using Excel and Power BI, analysing key metrics across matters. You will create and maintain Power BI dashboards ensuring outputs are accurate and client ready. You will also cleanse and check matter data including financial monitoring, escalating risks or anomalies in a timely way. The LPM Data Analyst will support repeatable reporting processes and help improve efficiency with legal technology initiatives involving automation and AI. You will also deliver training and guidance to help internal stakeholders interpret metrics and use approved tools effectively.
The role is a great opportunity to develop specialist skills in data, reporting, financial analysis and legal technology, while supporting the delivery of excellent legal services to clients and internal stakeholders.
Qualifications, Skills and Experience:
Essential:
Degree qualified in Law, Management, Finance, Business, Data/Analytics or a related subject, or equivalent relevant experience.
At least 1-3 years’ relevant experience in a professional services environment.
Strong analytical ability, financial acumen, understanding of key financial performance indicators and the ability to simplify complex data into clear communications.
Strong Microsoft 365 skills, strong IT literacy and an ability to become proficient in new software and systems quickly.
Advanced Excel capability, including formulas, lookups, arrays, pivot tables, calculated fields, slicers, charts, deduplication, profitability calculations, percentage calculations, Gantt charts and client-friendly formatting.
Basic Power BI capability or clear aptitude to develop it quickly, including dashboard creation, basic data modelling, basic DAX measures, custom columns, model relationships and integration of estimates into reporting models.
Awareness of confidentiality, permissions, information security and version control principles in the context of reporting and shared data environments.
Experience handling financial or operational data, including cleansing, reconciliation, validation, structuring, analysis and presentation of complex or imperfect data sets.
Interest in, and practical aptitude for, AI, GenAI, legal technology, collaboration software, automation and innovation in legal service delivery.
Communicate complex issues succinctly, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including lawyers, business finance and technology teams.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with attention to detail, an organised and practical mindset, strong time management and the ability to prioritise demanding workloads.
Desirable:
Strong Power BI capability, including dashboard creation, basic data modelling, DAX measures, custom columns, model relationships and integration of estimates into reporting models, or clear aptitude to develop these skills quickly.
Strong SharePoint and client portal capability, including site structure, permissions, document libraries, lists, user experience and risk-aware permission management.
Understanding of law firm economics.
Experience using Power Query, Power Automate and/or other low-code tools to improve data transformation, reporting and workflow efficiency.
Experience with advanced Power BI (complex DAX, parameterised queries), data extraction, SQL, Python, API-based reporting or equivalent approved coding and analytics methods.
Practical experience with AI, GenAI or machine learning tools applied to legal, financial or operational data analysis.
Experience using HighQ, virtual deal rooms or similar client-facing collaboration and document management platforms.
Regional language skills where relevant to the role and location.

We believe in positively impacting the lives of people around us and the environment we live in through the use of technology. We are searching for our next team members to join our growing team.

The successful candidate should be comfortable investigating issues across the application stack, understanding AWS infrastructure and networking dependencies, and working with DevOps and infrastructure engineers to resolve end-to-end problems.

Develop, enhance and maintain frontend and backend components of the platform.
Investigate and resolve application defects affecting portal workflows, resource provisioning and environment management.
Develop and maintain backend APIs and application services.
Implement validation, status tracking, error handling and workflow improvements.
Troubleshoot frontend, backend and integration issues across SIT, UAT and Production environments.
Support regression testing and end-to-end verification following application changes.

Work with AWS services and cloud integrations including:
Amazon ECS
Amazon EC2 / Auto Scaling

AWS Lambda

IAM

Troubleshoot Terraform and infrastructure provisioning failures.
Support enhancements to reusable infrastructure templates.
Work with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Investigate pipeline failures and application deployment issues.
Support container image management and vulnerability remediation.
Work closely with DevOps engineers on changes that span application and infrastructure components.

REST APIs and API Gateway
WebSocket connectivity

Support VAPT remediation activities.
Address container and dependency vulnerabilities.
Support NGINX, application dependency and container image upgrades.

title: Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Systems
description:
About Us
YYForce is building intelligent humanoid and service robots that can work safely and effectively alongside people. We are developing practical robotic capabilities for real-world deployment, with an initial focus on hospitality environments.
Our goal is to create a scalable robotics platform that brings together perception, manipulation, navigation, interaction and task execution—enabling robots to perform useful work reliably across different applications and environment.
About the Role
We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer, Autonomy Systems to develop the software foundation that connects our robot’s hardware, intelligence and application capabilities.
You will integrate robotics modules into a reliable system, define interfaces between components and build the tools needed to deploy, monitor and improve robots in the field. You will also explore how agentic planning and natural-language interaction can enable robots to understand requests and coordinate high-level tasks.
This is a hands-on role with strong ownership of system architecture, integration quality and robot reliability.
Key Responsibilities
· Design and maintain the software architecture connecting perception, manipulation, navigation, interaction and task execution.
· Develop reusable interfaces, services and hardware abstraction layers across different robot platforms.
· Integrate sensors, actuators, robot SDKs and third-party software into the robotics stack.
· Build task orchestration, state management, error handling and recovery mechanisms.
· Explore agentic task planning for high-level robot orchestration.
· Build tools for configuration ,logging, monitoring, diagnostics and remote support.
· Improve system performance ,reliability and maintainability through testing on physical robots.
· Support robot deployment and troubleshoot issues across hardware and software boundaries.
· Work closely with manipulation, perception, navigation and embodied AI engineers.
Minimum Requirements
· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field.
· Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python.
· Experience developing or integrating software for robotic or embedded systems.
· Experience with ROS or ROS 2and distributed software systems.
· Understanding of software architecture, APIs, concurrency and inter-process communication.
· Ability to diagnose complex system-level issues involving both hardware and software.
· Comfortable working hands-on with physical robots.
Strongly Preferred
· Experience integrating multiple robotics capabilities into a production or deployment-ready system.
· Experience with behavior trees, state machines, task planners or workflow orchestration.
· Experience integrating LLM- or VLM-based agents, tool calling or semantic task planning with deterministic robot-execution frameworks.
· Familiarity with Docker, Linux, CI/CD and software deployment on edge devices.
· Experience with telemetry, observability, fleet management or remote robot operations.
· Experience supporting robots in real-world customer environments.
What We Offer
· Ownership of the core software platform behind the humanoid robots
· The opportunity to shape the system architecture from an early stage.
· Hands-on access to humanoid robots, sensors, AI models and deployment environments.
· The freedom to turn emerging technologies—including embodied and agentic AI—into practical robotic capabilities.
· Direct involvement in taking robots from prototype to real hospitality operations.
· A high-impact role in a growing robotics team, with room to expand into technical leadership as the platform and team scale.
Work Type : Full-time |On-site

description:
Develop and deliver scalable transformation frameworks across Hadoop platforms by building robust data pipelines, ingestion frameworks, and automation capabilities. title: AI Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
We are looking for a Senior GenAI Application Engineer who operates effectively at the intersection of software engineering, GenAI applicationd evelopment, enterprise integration and production delivery.
This is not a pure research role. It is not a prompt engineering only role. The successful candidate will help design, build and improve production grade GenAI applications that are reliable, observable, maintainable and useful to real enterprise users.
Build and improve GenAI applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar orchestration tools.
Work with open weight models, hosted LLMs and model serving patterns.
Develop agentic workflows, retrieval augmented generation, tool calling and prompt orchestration.
Integrate GenAI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, data sources and operational platforms.
Engineer solutions for production quality, including logging, tracing, evaluation, fallback behaviour and troubleshooting.
Bring a strong can do attitude, enthusiasm, curiosity and practical delivery mindset.
Finance or banking experience is not required. What matters more is hands on experience building real GenAI applications, strong engineering judgement and the ability to deliver in a complex enterprise environment.
What Matters Most
Strong hands on experience building production grade GenAI applications.
Practical experience with LangGraph, LangChain, agentic workflows, RAG and tool calling.
Understanding of open weight models and how to integrate them into real applications.
Ability to challenge weak designs and propose better ones.
Strong engineering discipline around reliability, testing, observability and maintainability.
Ability to work across application, data, platform, security and infrastructure teams.
Enthusiastic, energetic and willing to get into the details.
Pragmatic approach to delivery, not over engineering, not hype driven.
Requirements:
6 or more years of software engineering experience, preferably with recent hands on experience in GenAI application development.
Proven experience building production grade GenAI applications, not only prototypes, experiments or demos.
Strong hands on experience with LangGraph, LangChain or similar orchestration frameworks.
Practical understanding of RAG, agentic workflows, tool calling, prompt orchestration and context management.
Experience integrating LLMs into real applications using APIs, backend services and enterprise data sources.
Experience with open weight models or strong interest backed by hands on experimentation.
Strong backend engineering skills using Python, Java or similar languages.
Good understanding of API design, distributed systems and production resilience patterns.
Experience with observability, logging, tracing and troubleshooting for GenAI or backend applications.
Familiarity with containerised deployment environments such as Kubernetes or OpenShift.
Ability to write clean, maintainable and testable code.
Strong analytical, debugging and troubleshooting skills.
High ownership, high curiosity and genuine interest in building useful AI products.
Ability to work in a fast moving environment with incomplete information and evolving requirements.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge weak designs and coordinate across business, application, data, infrastructure and security teams.
Nice to Have
Experience with DeepAgent or similar agent frameworks.
Experience with Langfuse, Elastic or similar observability and search tools.
Experience with Redis for caching, conversation state, rate limiting, queue backed workflows or low latency GenAI application patterns.
Experience with vLLM or similar inference serving frameworks for running open weight models.
Experience deploying GenAI workloads on cloud or container platforms
Key Domain/ Technical Skills
· Production GenAI Application Engineering
· LangGraph, LangChain, RAG and Agentic Workflows
Python, Java, APIs and Enterprise Integration

title: PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science
company: University of Cambridge, University of Manchester
description:
University of Cambridge, University of Manchester | PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science | ONSITE | UK home fee status only | £30k tax-free annual stipend
Our group at Cambridge works on Earth Observation foundation models (Tessera: v1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20380, v2 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03949, https://geotessera.org/) and we've started a collaboration with Manchester to understand how they can be used to improve pollution models and then environmental decision making in general. This involves training new models and doing high-resolution inference across national or even global scales, as well as figuring out how to use that data to help policymakers make better decisions.
As part of this work we have a PhD studentship through the joint Manchester-Cambridge Centre for Doctoral Training for AI in Decision Making for Complex Systems. This involves one year at Manchester doing taught postgraduate study and then three years at Cambridge for the PhD.
Our work is all open source and involves solving significant compute and data challenges. Training our current-generation model takes ~250k GPU hours and a single year of global inference needs to move over 5.5 petabytes of data through the inference pipeline. This project would suit someone with strong machine learning and software engineering experience. We can help you build the atmospheric science and Earth Observation skills.
We are a highly collaborative group who spend our time not only on foundational research but also on developing applications with practitioners and decision makers. Our work sees use in many industrial, academic and government environments for problems like crop classification, tree species mapping and change detection.
You can find out more here: https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/from-satellite-to-stre... - if you have questions about the project you can contact me, Sadiq Jaffer, at sj514@cam.ac.uk . For questions about the application process you'll want aidecisionscdt@manchester.ac.uk .
Application deadline is Friday 4th of December with a course start date of September 2027.

What you’ll bring
Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.

Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

title: Developer Support Engineer
description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.
At Algolia, we are passionate about helping developers and product teams connect their users with what matters most in milliseconds!
Algolia was built to help users deliver an intuitive search-as-you-type experience on their websites and mobile apps. We provide a search API used by thousands of customers in more than 100 countries, handling billions of search queries monthly.
The Developer Support Engineer is a critical role at Algolia. We’re on the front-lines and are often the first team customers contact when they need help with our products or services. We're looking for a Developer Support Engineer to assist our technical users with implementing Algolia in a variety of web and mobile development technical stacks.
This could mean helping a developer trying to build the next big thing in their garage, or Fortune 500 companies focused on providing a world-class experience to their millions of users.
As a Developer Support Engineer, you will partner with the customer success, product, and engineering teams to find the best solutions for our customers.. We have a hands-on culture, and expect you to roll up your sleeves and get to work solving difficult problems that stand in the way of our customers’ success.
YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:
Handling technical requests via web and email support channels.
Conducting professional and empathetic conversations with customers to gather information, troubleshoot, and resolve their technical obstacles.
Submitting bug reports to the Engineering team for problems needing attention.
Partnering with Product Teams and Engineering to develop subject matter expertise and serve as a product expert to the rest of the support team.
Contributing to internal and external knowledge bases.
Participating in internal projects to improve processes and tools.
REQUIREMENTS:
Strong desire to help people solve problems with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a broad audience
Experience with web development, REST APIs, and database management.
{ 1 - 2 } (dependent on level of seniority we are looking for) years of experience in technical customer support, supporting SaaS enterprise software ideally.
Working knowledge of development languages such as JavaScript, Java, PHP, C#, Objective-C, Swift, Ruby, Python.
Ability to handle and prioritize a portfolio of tickets at various stages of resolution.
Excellent spoken and written English skills..
Ability to work in an on-call rotation.
NICE TO HAVE:
Basic familiarity with iOS & Android platforms.
Experience supporting open-source projects & their GitHub communities.
Experience with Shopify, Magento.
#LI-Remote
Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Base Salary Pay Range
$100,000—$125,000 AUD
FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:
Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.
We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.

CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.

title: SRE / Devops Engineer - China based
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.
Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.
About the role
As a SRE / DevOps Engineer at Fever, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and reliable infrastructures, with a keen focus on automation.
If you’re experienced in developing infrastructures using AWS services, have strong knowledge of how to build CI/CD pipelines, and build systems with a security-first mindset, well then you’re exactly what we are looking for!
Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible. This is an opportunity to have real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
About you
Must have skills
Chinese nationality and current tax/legal residency in China (the role is fully based in China).
Professional working proficiency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin), with the ability to communicate and collaborate smoothly with remote and multidisciplinary global teams.
Availability to travel occasionally to Spain, particularly during the initial onboarding and training period.
Strong knowledge of DevOps culture, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.
Strong knowledge of Linux administration, troubleshooting, and automation using Python and Bash scripting.
Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, etc.).
Experience using Kubernetes in production environments.
Good understanding of networking and HTTP reverse proxies (OpenVPN, Nginx).
It would be nice if you have
Hands-on experience with Alibaba Cloud.
Working knowledge of Cloudflare or the ability and eagerness to learn it quickly.
Experience or knowledge in Data Privacy Engineering.
Familiarity or experience with AI tooling and LLM workflows (e.g., Kiro, OpenAI, Claude).
Database administration knowledge (MySQL & PostgreSQL).
Experience working as a Site Reliability and Security Engineer.
Knowledge of building service infrastructures for Python/NodeJS environments.
Knowledge of centralized logging techniques (rsyslog, ELK/EFK).
An open-minded and passionate approach to technology.
Experience working in agile environments.
About the process
Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:
Talent Interview (1h): An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.
Technical Assignment: Your opportunity to demonstrate all you know! We would like to receive it back within 7 days.
Team Interview (1.5h): A discussion about your proposed solution to the technical challenge, and your opportunity to ask anything you need to know about your day-to-day at Fever.
Benefits & Perks
Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
Stock options.
Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
Please note that this is a China based role, we will only consider candidates already based in China.

description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Cooperative internship period: Jan - May 2027 or Aug - Dec 2027
Get to Know our Team:
In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission-critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self-healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and C#, data technologies like Kafka and Spark, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team.
The Opportunity:
You might call yourself “full stack” or "back end" or you might consider yourself an authority in a certain field, but you will have a keen interest in how the different systems work together.
We'd love to hear from you if you are experienced in any of the technologies we work with (note - we are not looking for you to have them all). We are interested in speaking to persons of any level from individuals just starting their IT careers to experts in their field.
In this Role, you'll get to:
A chance to contribute to a top-notch codebase and work on scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that serve millions of requests
You will use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and C#, data technologies like Kafka and Spark, and agile development practices
You must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime
Think about the full life cycle of our products, and not just about a single piece of code - from product requirements, technology selection to coding standards, agile development, testing, deployment and monitoring
What you'll Need to Succeed:
Studying for a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or any related fields
Familiar with basics of Object-oriented and/or Functional programming
Familiar with relational and/or non-relational databases
Good English communication skill
Ready to learn fast
It's Great if you have:
Practical knowledge with Scala, C# or Java
You have built some back-end applications and services. You understand the basics of system scaling
Familiar with data platforms like MS SQL, Cassandra or Hadoop. You understand that different applications have different data requirements
Core engineering infrastructure tools like Git for source control, TeamCity for Continuous Integration and Puppet for deployment

The Opportunity:
Join us as an Intern in one of the Data Platform Teams which together manage the data infrastructure serving as the core backbone for all Agoda’s Data needs. The Data Platform spans four teams:
Data Pipeline: Maintaining large scale Data Pipelines spanning trillions of events a day across multiple Data Centers
Data Lake Operations: Administering our massive Hadoop Data Lakes at ~30+ PB scale for our data storage and computational needs
Data Applications: Creating self-service data tools/apps (e.g. ETL, Synchronization Tools, Discoverability Tools, Data Quality Tools etc.) for use by anyone in Agoda
Data Experience: Promoting Data Democratization and Usage through intuitive Web UIs that make it easy for any Agoda employee to interact with data
If you are interested in Data Engineering and Big Data, then this is the right internship program for you. You’ll have opportunity to work with large distributed system such as Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, Hadoop, Object Storage, Spark, Docker, Kubernetes etc.
In this Role, you'll get to:
Start off by learning about our Systems, going through the onboarding courses (based off one of the 4 teams that you’ll join)
Based on your interests, you’ll have an opportunity to choose which components you would like to work on.
At which point, you’ll be assigned a mentor. Together, you’ll then decide on an internship project and go through the full development cycle within the course of your internship.
You will take a project from ideation all the way to production. You would come up with an idea, develop a proof of concept, write tests, build dashboards, make your code production ready, deploy to production, debug issues, and learn how to automate everything.
Come out at the end of the Internship shipping real code, understanding what it takes to deal with TB to PB worth of data, how to design good and scalable software, learning more about large distributed systems, and seeing your code run in Production
What you'll Need to Succeed:
Be an Undergraduate / Graduate in an IT related / Computer Science or equivalent degree
Proficient in at least one of these languages: Go, Python
Good communication skills, Fast learner, Positive and Open Attitude
Ability to work independently and as a team player
Strong English speaking and writing skills
It's Great if you have:
Knowledge and experiences in Kubernetes, Apache Hive, Apache Iceberg

title: Business Developer France - Account Growth France 🇫🇷
description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.



Join us as a Business Developer - Account Growth France 🇫🇷 to grow our existing French customers and support them over the long term. Each month you get a fresh portfolio of customers flagged from usage data. You call them, understand what they need, and close the upsell or cross-sell that fits. You will work from our Barcelona office, within our Inside Sales team, and report to Mattia Ferrario https://www.linkedin.com/in/mattia-ferrario/, our Account Growth Lead.




➡️ What you’ll do

 - Work your monthly portfolio: Review a refreshed list of customers, and decide who to call first and why.

 - Call customers who aren’t expecting your call: Quickly explain why you’re reaching out and give them a reason to keep listening.

 - Identify needs and recommend solutions: Ask thoughtful, open-ended questions to understand customer needs. Identify opportunities and recommend solutions that genuinely fit.

 - Handle objections and drive sales: Understand customer concerns, address hesitation without pressure, and turn relevant opportunities into upsell and cross-sell deals. Agree on clear next steps or follow up with the prospect.

 - Represent the customer’s voice: Track your activity and monthly MRR, use data and AI tools to identify opportunities and potential risks, and share customer feedback with internal teams. Step in to handle inbound calls when needed.
   



➡️ What we’re looking for

 - Sales experience: 1–2 years in sales, ideally in an SDR, BDR, full-cycle or junior Account Executive role with outbound calling and a track record of closing deals. A strong outbound internship can also qualify.

 - Confident and clear communication: You quickly build trust with business owners, both over the phone and in writing. You are comfortable handling a high volume of conversations while keeping your communication clear, structured and engaging.

 - A consultative approach: You listen first and recommend what actually helps the customer. Familiarity with SPIN, BANT or SPICED is a plus.

 - Open to feedback and AI: You actively seek feedback and put it into practice to keep improving. You use AI tools in your daily work to save time, work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Languages and location: You speak fluent French (native or bilingual) and professional English (C1 or equivalent). You are based in Barcelona, and the role is onsite (no full remote).



➡️ What we can offer you

 - A team that is taking shape: The French expansion team has a new manager and its structure is being defined. You join early and help shape approaches and processes.

 - Coaching built into your week: Role plays and objection-handling practice with Mattia and your expansion peers.

 - Monthly variable compensation: Your pay reflects your performance month after month.

 - A portfolio that starts from data: You call existing customers flagged from usage signals, so every conversation has a concrete starting point.

 - A solid tool setup: Salesforce, Aircall and Modjo.



➡️ Your future manager

You will report to Mattia Ferrario https://www.linkedin.com/in/mattia-ferrario/, our Account Growth Lead.

 - His path? Mattia has solid experience building and scaling sales operations across Europe, and leads a team of 7.

 - What does he bring to the team? Clear standards, continuous feedback and hands-on support so you start well. Coaching, role plays and objection-handling practice are part of how he manages.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.



[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey



[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.



🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to support@qonto.com.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

We are looking for multiple Software Engineer Interns to join some of Back Market’s Engineering teams in the Paris office. Depending on your interests and experience, you may contribute to projects across our product, platform, data, payments, shipping, customer experience or circularity teams.

Our Engineering teams build the technology that powers Back Market, from customer-facing experiences to the internal services used by our teams and partners. You will work alongside software engineers, product managers, designers, data analysts and other stakeholders in a collaborative and international environment.

With support from experienced engineers, you will learn how we design, develop, test, deploy and monitor reliable software in a production environment.




WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will learn and contribute alongside experienced engineers:

 - Assist with developing and improving features, with guidance from your team.

 - Participate in writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

 - Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions to learn from the team.

 - Help investigate bugs and support the resolution of technical issues.

 - Participate in testing, deployment and monitoring activities.

 - Work with product, design, data and operations teams to understand requirements.

 - Assist with maintaining technical documentation and sharing knowledge.

 - Explore different technologies and gradually build your skills across the software development lifecycle.

You will join an agile "build it and run it" environment, where teams take part in building, launching, monitoring and improving the products and services they own. Your level of responsibility will grow throughout the internship, with regular guidance and feedback from your team.




OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT 💻

The technologies you use will depend on the team you join. Our engineering environment may include:

 - Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Golang and Django

 - Frontend: Vue.js, TypeScript, Nuxt and Revolve, our design system

 - Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ and BigQuery

 - Infrastructure and delivery: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Datadog, Argo CD, CircleCI and GitHub

You do not need experience with all of these technologies. We are more interested in your technical foundations, curiosity and willingness to learn.




YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

 - Mandatory! Currently enrolled in your final year of an Engineering School/University Master's degree and your university can provide an internship agreement - already based in France
